At that time, conditioned by ignorance are formations, with ignorance as their cause; conditioned by formations is consciousness, with formations as its cause; conditioned by consciousness is name, with consciousness as its cause; conditioned by name is the sixth sense base, with name as its cause; conditioned by the sixth sense base is contact, with the sixth sense base as its cause; conditioned by contact is feeling, with contact as its cause; conditioned by feeling is craving, with feeling as its cause; conditioned by craving is clinging, with craving as its cause; conditioned by clinging is becoming; conditioned by becoming is birth; conditioned by birth is aging-and-death. Thus is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.

257. Tattha [M 0.0155][P 0.0149] katamā avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjā”.

257. Therein, what is ignorance? Whatever is unknowing, not seeing… the bolt of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—this is called “ignorance.”

Tattha katamo avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāhetuko? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāhetuko”.

Therein, what are the formations conditioned by ignorance, with ignorance as their cause? Whatever is volition, thorough volition, the state of having willed—this is called “formations conditioned by ignorance, with ignorance as their cause.”

Tattha [V 0.0168] katamaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārahetukaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārahetukaṃ”.

Therein, what is consciousness conditioned by formations, with formations as its cause? Whatever is mind, intellect, mentation… the mind-consciousness element born of that—this is called “consciousness conditioned by formations, with formations as its cause.”

Tattha katamaṃ viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ viññāṇahetukaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ viññāṇahetukaṃ”.

Therein, what is name conditioned by consciousness, with consciousness as its cause? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of formations—this is called “name conditioned by consciousness, with consciousness as its cause.”

Tattha katamaṃ nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ nāmahetukaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ nāmahetukaṃ”.

Therein, what is the sixth sense base conditioned by name, with name as its cause? Whatever is mind, intellect, mentation… the mind-consciousness element born of that—this is called “the sixth sense base conditioned by name, with name as its cause.”

Tattha katamo chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso chaṭṭhāyatanahetuko? Yo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso chaṭṭhāyatanahetuko”.

Therein, what is contact conditioned by the sixth sense base, with the sixth sense base as its cause? Whatever is contact, touching, thorough touching, the state of having thoroughly touched—this is called “contact conditioned by the sixth sense base, with the sixth sense base as its cause.”

Tattha katamā phassapaccayā vedanā phassahetukā? Yaṃ cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā – ayaṃ vuccati “phassapaccayā vedanā phassahetukā”.

Therein, what is feeling conditioned by contact, with contact as its cause? Whatever is mental pleasure, mental happiness, a pleasant, happy feeling born of mind-contact, a pleasant, happy feeling that is born of mind-contact—this is called “feeling conditioned by contact, with contact as its cause.”

Tattha katamā vedanāpaccayā taṇhā vedanāhetukā? Yo rāgo sārāgo…pe… cittassa sārāgo – ayaṃ vuccati “vedanāpaccayā taṇhā vedanāhetukā”.

Therein, what is craving conditioned by feeling, with feeling as its cause? Whatever is passion, intense passion… intense passion of the mind—this is called “craving conditioned by feeling, with feeling as its cause.”

Tattha katamaṃ taṇhāpaccayā [T 0.0200] upādānaṃ taṇhāhetukaṃ? Yā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… titthāyatanaṃ vipariyāsaggāho – idaṃ vuccati “taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ taṇhāhetukaṃ”…pe… tena vuccati “evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti”ti.

Therein, what is clinging conditioned by craving, with craving as its cause? Whatever is view, adherence to views… a basis for views, perverse grasping—this is called “clinging conditioned by craving, with craving as its cause.” …pe… Therefore it is said: “Thus is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.”

258. Tasmiṃ [M 0.0156][P 0.0150] samaye avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāhetuko, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārahetukaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ viññāṇahetukaṃ, nāmapaccayā phasso nāmahetuko, phassapaccayā vedanā phassahetukā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā vedanāhetukā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ taṇhāhetukaṃ; upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

258. At that time, conditioned by ignorance are formations, with ignorance as their cause; conditioned by formations is consciousness, with formations as its cause; conditioned by consciousness is name, with consciousness as its cause; conditioned by name is contact, with name as its cause; conditioned by contact is feeling, with contact as its cause; conditioned by feeling is craving, with feeling as its cause; conditioned by craving is clinging, with craving as its cause; conditioned by clinging is becoming; conditioned by becoming is birth; conditioned by birth is aging-and-death. Thus is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.

259. Tattha [V 0.0169] katamā avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjā”.

259. Therein, what is ignorance? Whatever is unknowing, not seeing… the bolt of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—this is called “ignorance.”

Tattha katamo avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāhetuko? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāhetuko”.

Therein, what is the formation conditioned by ignorance, with ignorance as its cause? Whatever is volition, thorough volition, the state of having willed—this is called “the formation conditioned by ignorance, with ignorance as its cause.”

Tattha katamaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārahetukaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārahetukaṃ.

Therein, what is consciousness conditioned by formation, with formation as its cause? Whatever is mind, intellect, mentation… the mind-consciousness element born of that—this is called “consciousness conditioned by formation, with formation as its cause.”

Tattha katamaṃ viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ viññāṇahetukaṃ[T 0.0201]? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ viññāṇahetukaṃ”.

Therein, what is name conditioned by consciousness, with consciousness as its cause? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of formations—this is called “name conditioned by consciousness, with consciousness as its cause.”

Nāmapaccayā phasso nāmahetukoti. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Ṭhapetvā phassaṃ, vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho saṅkhārakkhandho viññāṇakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “nāmaṃ”.

Regarding “contact is conditioned by name, with name as its cause”: Therein, what is name? Excepting contact: the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of formations, and the aggregate of consciousness—this is called “name.”

Tattha katamo nāmapaccayā phasso nāmahetuko? Yo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “nāmapaccayā phasso nāmahetuko”…pe… tena vuccati “evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī”ti.

Therein, what is contact conditioned by name, with name as its cause? Whatever is contact, touching, impingement, the state of having impinged—this is called “contact conditioned by name, with name as its cause.” …pe… Therefore it is said: “Thus is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.”

260. Tasmiṃ samaye avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāhetuko, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārahetukaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇahetukaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ nāmarūpahetukaṃ, chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso chaṭṭhāyatanahetuko, phassapaccayā vedanā phassahetukā, vedanāpaccayā [M 0.0157] taṇhā vedanāhetukā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ taṇhāhetukaṃ; upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā [P 0.0151] jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

260. At that time, conditioned by ignorance, formation with ignorance as its cause arises; conditioned by formation, consciousness with formation as its cause arises; conditioned by consciousness, name-and-form with consciousness as its cause arises; conditioned by name-and-form, the sixth sense-base with name-and-form as its cause arises; conditioned by the sixth sense-base, contact with the sixth sense-base as its cause arises; conditioned by contact, feeling with contact as its cause arises; conditioned by feeling, craving with feeling as its cause arises; conditioned by craving, clinging with craving as its cause arises; conditioned by clinging, becoming arises; conditioned by becoming, birth arises; conditioned by birth, aging-and-death arises. Thus is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.

261. Tattha katamā avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjā”.

261. Therein, what is ignorance? Whatever is unknowing, not seeing… the bolt of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—this is called “ignorance.”

Tattha [V 0.0170] katamo avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāhetuko? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāhetuko”.

Therein, what is the formation conditioned by ignorance, with ignorance as its cause? Whatever is volition, thorough volition, the state of having willed—this is called “the formation conditioned by ignorance, with ignorance as its cause.”

Tattha [T 0.0202] katamaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārahetukaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārahetukaṃ”.

Therein, what is consciousness conditioned by formation, with formation as its cause? Whatever is mind, intellect, mentation… the mind-consciousness element born of that—this is called “consciousness conditioned by formation, with formation as its cause.”

Tattha katamaṃ viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇahetukaṃ? Atthi nāmaṃ, atthi rūpaṃ. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “nāmaṃ”. Tattha katamaṃ rūpaṃ? Cakkhāyatanassa upacayo, sotāyatanassa upacayo, ghānāyatanassa upacayo, jivhāyatanassa upacayo, kāyāyatanassa upacayo, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ cittajaṃ cittahetukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ – idaṃ vuccati “rūpaṃ”. Iti idañca nāmaṃ, idañca rūpaṃ. Idaṃ vuccati “viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇahetukaṃ”.

Therein, what is name-and-form conditioned by consciousness, with consciousness as its cause? There is name, and there is form. Therein, what is name? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of formations—this is called “name.” Therein, what is form? The accumulation of the eye-base, the accumulation of the ear-base, the accumulation of the nose-base, the accumulation of the tongue-base, the accumulation of the body-base, or whatever other form there is that is mind-born, mind-caused, and mind-originated—this is called “form.” Thus, this name and this form—this is called “name-and-form conditioned by consciousness, with consciousness as its cause.”

Nāmarūpapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ nāmarūpahetukanti. Atthi nāmaṃ, atthi rūpaṃ. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “nāmaṃ”. Tattha katamaṃ rūpaṃ? Yaṃ rūpaṃ nissāya manoviññāṇadhātu vattati – idaṃ vuccati “rūpaṃ”. Iti idañca nāmaṃ, idañca rūpaṃ. Idaṃ vuccati “nāmarūpaṃ”.

Regarding “the sixth sense-base is conditioned by name-and-form, with name-and-form as its cause”: Therein, there is name, and there is form. Therein, what is name? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, and the aggregate of formations—this is called “name.” Therein, what is form? That form depending on which the mind-consciousness element operates—this is called “form.” Thus, this name and this form—this is called “name-and-form.”

Tattha katamaṃ nāmarūpapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ nāmarūpahetukaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “nāmarūpapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ nāmarūpahetukaṃ”.

Therein, what is the sixth sense-base conditioned by name-and-form, with name-and-form as its cause? Whatever is mind, intellect, mentation… the mind-consciousness element born of that—this is called “the sixth sense-base conditioned by name-and-form, with name-and-form as its cause.”

Tattha katamo chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso chaṭṭhāyatanahetuko? Yo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso chaṭṭhāyatanahetuko”…pe… tena vuccati “evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī”ti.

Herein, what is contact conditioned by the sixth sense-base and caused by the sixth sense-base? Whatever is contact, the act of touching, the act of thorough touching, the state of having thoroughly touched—this is called 'contact conditioned by the sixth sense-base and caused by the sixth sense-base.'… Therefore it is said: 'Thus is the origin of this mass of suffering, unmixed with pleasure.'

262. Tasmiṃ [P 0.0152][M 0.0158] samaye avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāhetuko, saṅkhārapaccayā [T 0.0203] viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārahetukaṃ viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇahetukaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ nāmarūpahetukaṃ[V 0.0171], chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso chaṭṭhāyatanahetuko, phassapaccayā vedanā phassahetukā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā vedanāhetukā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ taṇhāhetukaṃ; upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

262. At that time, conditioned by ignorance, formation, which is caused by ignorance, arises. Conditioned by formation, consciousness, which is caused by formation, arises. Conditioned by consciousness, name-and-form, which is caused by consciousness, arises. Conditioned by name-and-form, the six sense-bases, which are caused by name-and-form, arise. Conditioned by the sixth sense-base, contact, which is caused by the sixth sense-base, arises. Conditioned by contact, feeling, which is caused by contact, arises. Conditioned by feeling, craving, which is caused by feeling, arises. Conditioned by craving, clinging, which is caused by craving, arises. Conditioned by clinging, becoming arises. Conditioned by becoming, birth arises. Conditioned by birth, aging-and-death arises. Thus is the origin of this mass of suffering, unmixed with pleasure.

263. Tattha katamā avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjā”.

263. Herein, what is ignorance? Whatever is not knowing, not seeing… the bolt of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—this is called 'ignorance'.

Tattha katamo avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāhetuko? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāhetuko”.

Herein, what is the formation conditioned by ignorance and caused by ignorance? Whatever is volition, the act of intending, the state of having intended—this is called 'the formation conditioned by ignorance and caused by ignorance'.

Tattha katamaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārahetukaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārahetukaṃ”.

Herein, what is consciousness conditioned by formation and caused by formation? Whatever is mind, heart, or intellect… the corresponding mind-consciousness-element—this is called 'consciousness conditioned by formation and caused by formation'.

Tattha katamaṃ viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇahetukaṃ? Atthi nāmaṃ, atthi rūpaṃ. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “nāmaṃ”. Tattha katamaṃ rūpaṃ? Cakkhāyatanassa upacayo, sotāyatanassa upacayo, ghānāyatanassa upacayo, jivhāyatanassa upacayo, kāyāyatanassa upacayo, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ cittajaṃ cittahetukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ – idaṃ vuccati “rūpaṃ”. Iti idañca nāmaṃ, idañca rūpaṃ. Idaṃ vuccati “viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇahetukaṃ”.

Herein, what is name-and-form conditioned by consciousness and caused by consciousness? There is name, there is form. Herein, what is name? The feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, the formations aggregate—this is called 'name.' Herein, what is form? The accumulation of the eye-base, the accumulation of the ear-base, the accumulation of the nose-base, the accumulation of the tongue-base, the accumulation of the body-base, or whatever other form there is that is mind-born, mind-caused, mind-originated—this is called 'form.' Thus, this name and this form are called 'name-and-form conditioned by consciousness and caused by consciousness'.

Nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ nāmarūpahetukanti. Atthi nāmaṃ, atthi rūpaṃ. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho[T 0.0204], saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “nāmaṃ”. Tattha katamaṃ rūpaṃ? Cattāro ca mahābhūtā, yañca rūpaṃ nissāya manoviññāṇadhātu vattati – idaṃ vuccati “rūpaṃ”. Iti idañca nāmaṃ, idañca rūpaṃ. Idaṃ vuccati “nāmarūpaṃ”.

In the phrase 'Conditioned by name-and-form, the six sense-bases, which are caused by name-and-form': There is name, there is form. Herein, what is name? The feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, and the formations aggregate—this is called 'name.' Herein, what is form? The four great elements and that form depending on which the mind-consciousness-element operates—this is called 'form.' Thus, this name and this form are called 'name-and-form'.

Tattha katamaṃ nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ nāmarūpahetukaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ[P 0.0153], sotāyatanaṃ, ghānāyatanaṃ[V 0.0172], jivhāyatanaṃ, kāyāyatanaṃ, manāyatanaṃ – idaṃ vuccati “nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ nāmarūpahetukaṃ”.

Therein, what is the sixfold sense-base conditioned by name-and-form, having name-and-form as its cause? The eye-base, the ear-base, the nose-base, the tongue-base, the body-base, the mind-base—this is called 'the sixfold sense-base conditioned by name-and-form, having name-and-form as its cause'.

Tattha [M 0.0159] katamo chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso chaṭṭhāyatanahetuko? Yo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso chaṭṭhāyatanahetuko”.

Therein, what is contact conditioned by the sixth sense-base, having the sixth sense-base as its cause? Whatever is contact, the act of touching, the act of thorough touching, the state of having been thoroughly touched—this is called 'contact conditioned by the sixth sense-base, having the sixth sense-base as its cause'.

Tattha katamā phassapaccayā vedanā phassahetukā? Yaṃ cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā – ayaṃ vuccati “phassapaccayā vedanā phassahetukā”.

Therein, what is feeling conditioned by contact, having contact as its cause? Whatever is mental pleasure, mental happiness; whatever pleasant, happy feeling is born of mind-contact; whatever pleasant, happy feeling is born of mind-contact—this is called 'feeling conditioned by contact, having contact as its cause'.

Tattha katamā vedanāpaccayā taṇhā vedanāhetukā? Yo rāgo sārāgo…pe… cittassa sārāgo – ayaṃ vuccati “vedanāpaccayā taṇhā vedanāhetukā”.

Therein, what is craving conditioned by feeling, having feeling as its cause? Whatever is lust, intense lust... the intense lust of the mind—this is called 'craving conditioned by feeling, having feeling as its cause'.

Tattha katamaṃ taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ taṇhāhetukaṃ? Yā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… titthāyatanaṃ vipariyāsaggāho – idaṃ vuccati “taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ taṇhāhetukaṃ”…pe… tena vuccati “evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī”ti.

Therein, what is clinging conditioned by craving, having craving as its cause? Whatever is a view, that which has become a view... a basis for views, a perverse grasping—this is called 'clinging conditioned by craving, having craving as its cause'... Therefore, it is said: 'Thus is the origin of this mass of suffering, unmixed with pleasure.'

Hetucatukkaṃ.

The Tetrad on Cause.

7. Sampayuttacatukkaṃ

7. The Tetrad on Association.

Tasmiṃ samaye avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāsampayutto, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārasampayuttaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ viññāṇasampayuttaṃ, nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ nāmasampayuttaṃ, chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso chaṭṭhāyatanasampayutto, phassapaccayā vedanā phassasampayuttā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā vedanāsampayuttā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ taṇhāsampayuttaṃ; upādānapaccayā [V 0.0173] bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

At that time, conditioned by ignorance, a formation associated with ignorance arises; conditioned by a formation, consciousness associated with a formation arises; conditioned by consciousness, name associated with consciousness arises; conditioned by name, the sixth sense-base associated with name arises; conditioned by the sixth sense-base, contact associated with the sixth sense-base arises; conditioned by contact, feeling associated with contact arises; conditioned by feeling, craving associated with feeling arises; conditioned by craving, clinging associated with craving arises; conditioned by clinging, becoming arises; conditioned by becoming, birth arises; conditioned by birth, aging-and-death arises. Thus is the origin of this mass of suffering, unmixed with pleasure.

265. Tattha katamā avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjā”.

265. Therein, what is ignorance? Whatever is not knowing, not seeing... the bolt of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—this is called 'ignorance'.

Tattha [M 0.0160] katamo avijjāpaccayā [T 0.0205] saṅkhāro avijjāsampayutto? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāsampayutto”.

Therein, what is the formation conditioned by ignorance and associated with ignorance? Whatever is volition, the act of intending, the state of having intended—this is called 'the formation conditioned by ignorance and associated with ignorance'.

Tattha katamaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārasampayuttaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārasampayuttaṃ”.

Therein, what is consciousness conditioned by a formation and associated with a formation? Whatever is mind, heart, intellect... the corresponding mind-consciousness-element—this is called 'consciousness conditioned by a formation and associated with a formation'.

Tattha katamaṃ viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ viññāṇasampayuttaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ viññāṇasampayuttaṃ”.

Therein, what is name conditioned by consciousness and associated with consciousness? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, and the aggregate of formations—this is called 'name conditioned by consciousness and associated with consciousness'.

Tattha katamaṃ nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ nāmasampayuttaṃ? Yaṃ [P 0.0154] cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ nāmasampayuttaṃ”.

Therein, what is the sixth sense-base conditioned by name and associated with name? Whatever is mind, intellect, consciousness... that which is the corresponding mind-consciousness-element—this is called 'the sixth sense-base conditioned by name and associated with name'.

Tattha katamo chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso chaṭṭhāyatanasampayutto? Yo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso chaṭṭhāyatanasampayutto”.

Therein, what is the contact conditioned by the sixth sense-base and associated with the sixth sense-base? Whatever is contact, touching, complete touching, the state of having been completely touched—this is called 'the contact conditioned by the sixth sense-base and associated with the sixth sense-base'.

Tattha katamā phassapaccayā vedanā phassasampayuttā? Yaṃ cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā – ayaṃ vuccati “phassapaccayā vedanā phassasampayuttā”.

Therein, what is the feeling conditioned by contact and associated with contact? Whatever is mental pleasure, mental happiness; a pleasant, happy experience born of mind-contact; a pleasant, happy feeling born of mind-contact—this is called 'the feeling conditioned by contact and associated with contact'.

Tattha katamā vedanāpaccayā taṇhā vedanāsampayuttā? Yo rāgo sārāgo…pe… cittassa sārāgo – ayaṃ vuccati “vedanāpaccayā taṇhā vedanāsampayuttā”.

Therein, what is the craving conditioned by feeling and associated with feeling? Whatever is lust, intense lust... the intense lust of the mind—this is called 'the craving conditioned by feeling and associated with feeling'.

Tattha [V 0.0174] katamaṃ taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ taṇhāsampayuttaṃ? Yā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… titthāyatanaṃ vipariyāsaggāho – idaṃ vuccati “taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ taṇhāsampayuttaṃ” [T 0.0206] …pe… tena vuccati “evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī”ti.

Therein, what is the clinging conditioned by craving and associated with craving? Whatever is wrong view, that which has become a wrong view... a basis for wrong views, a perverse grasping—this is called 'the clinging conditioned by craving and associated with craving'... Therefore, it is said: 'Thus is the arising of this entire mass of suffering'.

266. Tasmiṃ samaye avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāsampayutto, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārasampayuttaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ viññāṇasampayuttaṃ, nāmapaccayā phasso nāmasampayutto, phassapaccayā vedanā phassasampayuttā[M 0.0161], vedanāpaccayā taṇhā vedanāsampayuttā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ taṇhāsampayuttaṃ; upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

266. At that time, conditioned by ignorance, a formation associated with ignorance arises; conditioned by a formation, consciousness associated with a formation arises; conditioned by consciousness, name associated with consciousness arises; conditioned by name, contact associated with name arises; conditioned by contact, feeling associated with contact arises; conditioned by feeling, craving associated with feeling arises; conditioned by craving, clinging associated with craving arises; conditioned by clinging, becoming arises; conditioned by becoming, birth arises; conditioned by birth, aging-and-death arises. Thus is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.

267. Tattha katamā avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjā”.

267. Therein, what is ignorance? Whatever is not-knowing, not-seeing... the bolt of ignorance, delusion which is the unwholesome root—this is called 'ignorance'.

Tattha katamo avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāsampayutto? Yā [P 0.0155] cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāsampayutto”.

Therein, what is the formation conditioned by ignorance and associated with ignorance? Whatever is volition, intending, the state of having intended—this is called 'the formation conditioned by ignorance and associated with ignorance'.

Tattha katamaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārasampayuttaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārasampayuttaṃ”.

Therein, what is the consciousness conditioned by a formation and associated with a formation? Whatever is mind, intellect, consciousness... that which is the corresponding mind-consciousness-element—this is called 'the consciousness conditioned by a formation and associated with a formation'.

Tattha katamaṃ viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ viññāṇasampayuttaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ viññāṇasampayuttaṃ”.

Therein, what is name conditioned by consciousness and associated with consciousness? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, and the aggregate of volitional formations—this is called 'name conditioned by consciousness and associated with consciousness'.

Nāmapaccayā phasso nāmasampayuttoti. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Ṭhapetvā phassaṃ, vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho saṅkhārakkhandho [T 0.0207] viññāṇakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “nāmaṃ”.

Regarding 'Conditioned by name, contact is associated with name': Therein, what is name? Excluding contact, the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of volitional formations, and the aggregate of consciousness—this is called 'name'.

Tattha katamo nāmapaccayā phasso nāmasampayutto? Yo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “nāmapaccayā phasso nāmasampayutto”…pe… tena vuccati “evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī”ti.

Therein, what is contact conditioned by name and associated with name? Whatever is contact, touching, complete touching, the state of having been completely touched—this is called 'contact conditioned by name and associated with name.'... Therefore, it is said: 'Thus is the arising of this entire mass of suffering'.

268. Tasmiṃ [V 0.0175] samaye avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāsampayutto, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārasampayuttaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇasampayuttaṃ nāmaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ nāmasampayuttaṃ, chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso chaṭṭhāyatanasampayutto, phassapaccayā vedanā phassasampayuttā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā vedanāsampayuttā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ taṇhāsampayuttaṃ; upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā [M 0.0162] jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

268. At that time, conditioned by ignorance, a formation associated with ignorance arises; conditioned by a formation, consciousness associated with a formation arises; conditioned by consciousness, name-and-form arises, the name component being associated with consciousness; conditioned by name-and-form, the sixth sense-base associated with name arises; conditioned by the sixth sense-base, contact associated with the sixth sense-base arises; conditioned by contact, feeling associated with contact arises; conditioned by feeling, craving associated with feeling arises; conditioned by craving, clinging associated with craving arises; conditioned by clinging, becoming arises; conditioned by becoming, birth arises; conditioned by birth, aging-and-death arise. Thus is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.

269. Tattha katamā avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjā”.

269. Therein, what is ignorance? Whatever is not-knowing, not-seeing... the bolt of ignorance, delusion which is the unwholesome root—this is called 'ignorance'.

Tattha katamo avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāsampayutto? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāsampayutto”.

Therein, what is the formation conditioned by ignorance and associated with ignorance? Whatever is volition, intending, the state of having intended—this is called 'the formation conditioned by ignorance and associated with ignorance'.

Tattha [P 0.0156] katamaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārasampayuttaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ …pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārasampayuttaṃ”.

Therein, what is consciousness conditioned by a formation and associated with a formation? Whatever is mind, intellect, consciousness... the mind-consciousness element born of that—this is called 'consciousness conditioned by a formation and associated with a formation'.

Tattha katamaṃ [T 0.0208] viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇasampayuttaṃ nāmaṃ? Atthi nāmaṃ, atthi rūpaṃ. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “nāmaṃ”. Tattha katamaṃ rūpaṃ? Cakkhāyatanassa upacayo, sotāyatanassa upacayo, ghānāyatanassa upacayo, jivhāyatanassa upacayo, kāyāyatanassa upacayo, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ cittajaṃ cittahetukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ – idaṃ vuccati “rūpaṃ”. Iti idañca nāmaṃ, idañca rūpaṃ. Idaṃ vuccati “viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇasampayuttaṃ nāmaṃ”.

Therein, what is name-and-form conditioned by consciousness, with the name component associated with consciousness? There is name, there is form. Therein, what is name? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, and the aggregate of volitional formations—this is called 'name'. Therein, what is form? The accrual of the eye-base, the accrual of the ear-base, the accrual of the nose-base, the accrual of the tongue-base, the accrual of the body-base, or whatever other form there is that is mind-born, mind-caused, mind-originated—this is called 'form'. Thus, this is name, and this is form. This is called 'name-and-form conditioned by consciousness, with the name component associated with consciousness'.

Nāmarūpapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ nāmasampayuttanti. Atthi nāmaṃ, atthi rūpaṃ. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “nāmaṃ”. Tattha katamaṃ rūpaṃ? Yaṃ rūpaṃ nissāya manoviññāṇadhātu vattati – idaṃ vuccati “rūpaṃ”. Iti idañca nāmaṃ, idañca rūpaṃ. Idaṃ vuccati “nāmarūpaṃ”.

Regarding 'With name-and-form as condition, the sixth sense base [arises], associated with name': There is name, there is form. Herein, what is name? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of volitional formations—this is called 'name'. Herein, what is form? The form depending on which the mind-consciousness element occurs—this is called 'form'. Thus, this is name, and this is form. This is called 'name-and-form'.

Tattha [V 0.0176] katamaṃ nāmarūpapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ nāmasampayuttaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “nāmarūpapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ nāmasampayuttaṃ”.

Herein, what is the sixth sense base conditioned by name-and-form, associated with name? Whatever is mind, thought, intellect... the mind-consciousness element born of that—this is called 'the sixth sense base conditioned by name-and-form, associated with name'.

Tattha katamo chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso chaṭṭhāyatanasampayutto? Yo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso chaṭṭhāyatanasampayutto”…pe… tena vuccati “evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī”ti.

Herein, what is contact conditioned by the sixth sense base, associated with the sixth sense base? Whatever is contact, touching, thorough touching, the state of having been thoroughly touched—this is called 'contact conditioned by the sixth sense base, associated with the sixth sense base.'... Therefore, it is said: 'Thus is the arising of this entire mass of suffering'.

270. Tasmiṃ [M 0.0163] samaye avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāsampayutto, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārasampayuttaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇasampayuttaṃ nāmaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ nāmasampayuttaṃ [T 0.0209] chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ, chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso chaṭṭhāyatanasampayutto, phassapaccayā [P 0.0157] vedanā phassasampayuttā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā vedanāsampayuttā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ taṇhāsampayuttaṃ; upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

270. At that time, with ignorance as condition, volitional formations associated with ignorance [arise]; with volitional formations as condition, consciousness associated with volitional formations [arises]; with consciousness as condition, name-and-form, with name being associated with consciousness, [arises]; with name-and-form as condition, the six sense bases, with the sixth sense base being associated with name, [arise]; with the sixth sense base as condition, contact associated with the sixth sense base [arises]; with contact as condition, feeling associated with contact [arises]; with feeling as condition, craving associated with feeling [arises]; with craving as condition, clinging associated with craving [arises]; with clinging as condition, becoming [arises]; with becoming as condition, birth [arises]; with birth as condition, aging-and-death [arises]. Thus is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.

271. Tattha katamā avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjā”.

271. Herein, what is ignorance? Whatever is not knowing, not seeing... the bolt of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—this is called 'ignorance'.

Tattha katamo avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāsampayutto? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro avijjāsampayutto”.

Herein, what is the volitional formation conditioned by ignorance, associated with ignorance? Whatever is volition, co-volition, the state of having intended—this is called 'the volitional formation conditioned by ignorance, associated with ignorance'.

Tattha katamaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārasampayuttaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ saṅkhārasampayuttaṃ”.

Herein, what is consciousness conditioned by volitional formations, associated with volitional formations? Whatever is mind, mentality, consciousness... the mind-consciousness element born of that—this is called 'consciousness conditioned by volitional formations, associated with volitional formations'.

Tattha katamaṃ viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇasampayuttaṃ nāmaṃ? Atthi nāmaṃ, atthi rūpaṃ. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “nāmaṃ”. Tattha katamaṃ rūpaṃ? Cakkhāyatanassa upacayo, sotāyatanassa upacayo, ghānāyatanassa upacayo, jivhāyatanassa upacayo, kāyāyatanassa upacayo, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi [V 0.0177] rūpaṃ cittajaṃ cittahetukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ – idaṃ vuccati “rūpaṃ”. Iti idañca nāmaṃ, idañca rūpaṃ. Idaṃ vuccati “viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇasampayuttaṃ nāmaṃ”.

Herein, what is 'name-and-form conditioned by consciousness, with name associated with consciousness'? There is name, there is form. Herein, what is name? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of formations—this is called 'name'. Herein, what is form? The accumulation of the eye-base, the accumulation of the ear-base, the accumulation of the nose-base, the accumulation of the tongue-base, the accumulation of the body-base, or whatever other form there is that is mind-born, mind-caused, mind-originated—this is called 'form'. Thus, this is name, and this is form. This is called 'name-and-form conditioned by consciousness, with name associated with consciousness'.

Nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ nāmasampayuttaṃ chaṭṭhāyatananti. Atthi nāmaṃ, atthi rūpaṃ. Tattha [T 0.0210] katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “nāmaṃ”. Tattha katamaṃ rūpaṃ? Cattāro ca mahābhūtā, yañca rūpaṃ nissāya manoviññāṇadhātu vattati – idaṃ vuccati “rūpaṃ”. Iti idañca nāmaṃ, idañca rūpaṃ. Idaṃ vuccati “nāmarūpaṃ”.

Regarding 'the six sense bases conditioned by name-and-form, with the sixth sense base associated with name'. There is name, there is form. Herein, what is name? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of formations—this is called 'name'. Herein, what is form? The four great elements, and that form depending on which the mind-consciousness element occurs—this is called 'form'. Thus, this is name, and this is form. This is called 'name-and-form'.

Tattha katamaṃ nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ nāmasampayuttaṃ chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ, sotāyatanaṃ, ghānāyatanaṃ, jivhāyatanaṃ, kāyāyatanaṃ, manāyatanaṃ [M 0.0164] – idaṃ vuccati “nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ nāmasampayuttaṃ chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ”.

Herein, what are 'the six sense bases conditioned by name-and-form, with the sixth sense base associated with name'? The eye-base, the ear-base, the nose-base, the tongue-base, the body-base, the mind-base—this is called 'the six sense bases conditioned by name-and-form, with the sixth sense base associated with name'.

Tattha [P 0.0158] katamo chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso chaṭṭhāyatanasampayutto? Yo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso chaṭṭhāyatanasampayutto”…pe… tena vuccati “evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī”ti.

Herein, what is 'contact conditioned by the sixth sense base, associated with the sixth sense base'? Whatever is contact, touching, thorough touching, the state of having been thoroughly touched—this is called 'contact conditioned by the sixth sense base, associated with the sixth sense base.'... Therefore it is said, 'Thus is the arising of this entire mass of suffering'.

Sampayuttacatukkaṃ.

The Tetrad of Association.

8. Aññamaññacatukkaṃ

8. The Tetrad of Reciprocity.

272. Tasmiṃ samaye avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro, saṅkhārapaccayāpi avijjā; saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayāpi saṅkhāro; viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ, nāmapaccayāpi viññāṇaṃ; nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ, chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayāpi nāmaṃ; chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayāpi chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ; phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayāpi phasso; vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayāpi vedanā; taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayāpi taṇhā; upādānapaccayā [V 0.0178] bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

272. At that time, with ignorance as condition, formations arise; also with formations as condition, ignorance arises. With formations as condition, consciousness arises; also with consciousness as condition, formations arise. With consciousness as condition, name arises; also with name as condition, consciousness arises. With name as condition, the sixth sense base arises; also with the sixth sense base as condition, name arises. With the sixth sense base as condition, contact arises; also with contact as condition, the sixth sense base arises. With contact as condition, feeling arises; also with feeling as condition, contact arises. With feeling as condition, craving arises; also with craving as condition, feeling arises. With craving as condition, clinging arises; also with clinging as condition, craving arises. With clinging as condition, becoming arises. With becoming as condition, birth arises. With birth as condition, aging-and-death arises. Thus is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.

273. Tattha [T 0.0211] katamā avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjā”.

273. Herein, what is ignorance? Whatever is not-knowing, not-seeing... the bolt of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—this is called 'ignorance'.

Tattha katamo avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro”.

Herein, what are 'formations conditioned by ignorance'? Whatever is volition, co-volition, the state of having willed—this is called 'formations conditioned by ignorance'.

Tattha katamā saṅkhārapaccayāpi avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “saṅkhārapaccayāpi avijjā”.

Herein, what is 'ignorance also conditioned by formations'? Whatever is not-knowing, not-seeing... the bolt of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—this is called 'ignorance also conditioned by formations'.

Tattha katamaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ.

Herein, what is 'consciousness conditioned by formations'? That which is mind, mentation, consciousness... the mind-consciousness-element born of that—this is called 'consciousness conditioned by formations'.

Tattha katamo viññāṇapaccayāpi saṅkhāro? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “viññāṇapaccayāpi saṅkhāro”.

Herein, what is 'formations also conditioned by consciousness'? That which is volition, thorough volition, the state of having willed—this is called 'formations also conditioned by consciousness'.

Tattha [M 0.0165] katamaṃ viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ”.

Herein, what is 'name conditioned by consciousness'? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of formations—this is called 'name conditioned by consciousness'.

Tattha katamaṃ nāmapaccayāpi viññāṇaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “nāmapaccayāpi viññāṇaṃ”.

Herein, what is 'consciousness also conditioned by name'? That which is mind, mentation, consciousness... the mind-consciousness-element born of that—this is called 'consciousness also conditioned by name'.

Tattha [P 0.0159] katamaṃ nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ”.

Herein, what is 'the sixth sense-base conditioned by name'? That which is mind, mentation, consciousness... the mind-consciousness-element born of that—this is called 'the sixth sense-base conditioned by name'.

Tattha [V 0.0179] katamaṃ chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayāpi nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho[T 0.0212], saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayāpi nāmaṃ”.

Herein, what is 'name also conditioned by the sixth sense-base'? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of formations—this is called 'name also conditioned by the sixth sense-base'.

Tattha katamo chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso? Yo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso”.

Herein, what is 'contact conditioned by the sixth sense-base'? That which is contact, touching, thorough touching, the state of having been thoroughly touched—this is called 'contact conditioned by the sixth sense-base'.

Tattha katamaṃ phassapaccayāpi chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “phassapaccayāpi chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ”.

Herein, what is 'the sixth sense-base also conditioned by contact'? That which is mind, mentation, consciousness... the mind-consciousness-element born of that—this is called 'the sixth sense-base also conditioned by contact'.

Tattha katamā phassapaccayā vedanā? Yaṃ cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā – ayaṃ vuccati “phassapaccayā vedanā”.

Herein, what is 'feeling conditioned by contact'? That which is mental agreeableness, mental pleasure; the agreeable, pleasant experience born of mental contact; the agreeable, pleasant feeling born of mental contact—this is called 'feeling conditioned by contact'.

Tattha katamo vedanāpaccayāpi phasso? Yo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “vedanāpaccayāpi phasso”.

Herein, what is 'contact also conditioned by feeling'? That which is contact, touching, thorough touching, the state of having been thoroughly touched—this is called 'contact also conditioned by feeling'.

Tattha katamā vedanāpaccayā taṇhā? Yo rāgo sārāgo…pe… cittassa sārāgo – ayaṃ vuccati “vedanāpaccayā taṇhā”.

Herein, what is 'craving conditioned by feeling'? That which is lust, intense passion... intense passion of the mind—this is called 'craving conditioned by feeling'.

Tattha katamā taṇhāpaccayāpi vedanā? Yaṃ cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā – ayaṃ vuccati “taṇhāpaccayāpi vedanā”.

Herein, what is 'feeling also conditioned by craving'? That which is mental agreeableness, mental pleasure; the agreeable, pleasant experience born of mental contact; the agreeable, pleasant feeling born of mental contact—this is called 'feeling also conditioned by craving'.

Tattha katamaṃ taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ? Yā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ…pe… titthāyatanaṃ vipariyāsaggāho – idaṃ vuccati “taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ”.

Herein, what is 'clinging conditioned by craving'? Whatever is view, adherence to views... a resort of views, a perverted grasping—this is called 'clinging conditioned by craving'.

Tattha katamā upādānapaccayāpi taṇhā? Yo rāgo…pe… cittassa [T 0.0213] sārāgo – ayaṃ vuccati “upādānapaccayāpi taṇhā”.

Herein, what is 'craving also conditioned by clinging'? Whatever is lust... the intense passion of the mind—this is called 'craving also conditioned by clinging'.

Tattha [M 0.0166] katamo upādānapaccayā bhavo? Ṭhapetvā upādānaṃ, vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho saṅkhārakkhandho viññāṇakkhandho – ayaṃ vuccati “upādānapaccayā bhavo”.

Herein, what is 'becoming conditioned by clinging'? Except for clinging, the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of formations, the aggregate of consciousness—this is called 'becoming conditioned by clinging'.

Tattha katamā bhavapaccayā jāti? Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ jāti sañjāti nibbatti abhinibbati pātubhāvo – ayaṃ vuccati “bhavapaccayā jāti”.

Herein, what is 'birth conditioned by becoming'? The birth, complete birth, coming into existence, arising anew, appearance of those various phenomena—this is called 'birth conditioned by becoming'.

Tattha katamaṃ jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ? Atthi jarā, atthi maraṇaṃ. Tattha katamā jarā? Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ jarā jīraṇatā āyuno saṃhāni – ayaṃ vuccati [P 0.0160] “jarā”. Tattha katamaṃ maraṇaṃ? Yo tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ khayo vayo bhedo paribhedo aniccatā antaradhānaṃ – idaṃ vuccati “maraṇaṃ”. Iti ayañca jarā, idañca maraṇaṃ. Idaṃ vuccati “jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ”.

Herein, what is 'aging-and-death conditioned by birth'? There is aging, there is death. Herein, what is aging? The aging, decrepitude, decline of the life-faculty of those various phenomena—this is called 'aging.' Herein, what is death? The decay, passing away, breaking up, complete breaking up, impermanence, disappearance of those various phenomena—this is called 'death.' Thus, this aging and this death—this is called 'aging-and-death conditioned by birth'.

Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotīti. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa saṅgati hoti, samāgamo hoti, samodhānaṃ hoti, pātubhāvo hoti. Tena vuccati “evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī”ti.

Thus there is the arising of this entire mass of suffering. Thus there is the coming together, the convergence, the combination, the manifestation of this entire mass of suffering. Therefore it is said: 'Thus there is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.'

274. Tasmiṃ samaye avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro, saṅkhārapaccayāpi avijjā; saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayāpi saṅkhāro; viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ, nāmapaccayāpi viññāṇaṃ; nāmapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayāpi nāmaṃ; phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayāpi phasso; vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayāpi vedanā; taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ[T 0.0214], upādānapaccayāpi taṇhā; upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

274. At that time, with ignorance as a condition, formations; also with formations as a condition, ignorance. With formations as a condition, consciousness; also with consciousness as a condition, formations. With consciousness as a condition, name; also with name as a condition, consciousness. With name as a condition, contact; also with contact as a condition, name. With contact as a condition, feeling; also with feeling as a condition, contact. With feeling as a condition, craving; also with craving as a condition, feeling. With craving as a condition, clinging; also with clinging as a condition, craving. With clinging as a condition, becoming; with becoming as a condition, birth; with birth as a condition, aging-and-death. Thus there is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.

275. Tattha katamā avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjā”.

275. Herein, what is ignorance? Whatever is not knowing, not seeing... the bolt of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—this is called 'ignorance'.

Tattha katamo avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro”.

Herein, what is 'formations conditioned by ignorance'? Whatever is volition, thorough volition, the state of having willed—this is called 'formations conditioned by ignorance'.

Tattha [V 0.0181] katamā saṅkhārapaccayāpi avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “saṅkhārapaccayāpi avijjā”.

Herein, what is 'ignorance also conditioned by formations'? Whatever is not knowing, not seeing... the bolt of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—this is called 'ignorance also conditioned by formations'.

Tattha [M 0.0167] katamaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ”.

Herein, what is 'consciousness conditioned by formations'? That which is mind, mentation, consciousness... the mind-consciousness-element born of that—this is called 'consciousness conditioned by formations'.

Tattha katamo viññāṇapaccayāpi saṅkhāro? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “viññāṇapaccayāpi saṅkhāro”.

Herein, what is 'formations also conditioned by consciousness'? Whatever is volition, thorough volition, the state of having willed—this is called 'formations also conditioned by consciousness'.

Tattha katamaṃ viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ”.

Herein, what is name conditioned by consciousness? The feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, the formations aggregate—this is called "name conditioned by consciousness."

Tattha katamaṃ nāmapaccayāpi viññāṇaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “nāmapaccayāpi viññāṇaṃ”.

Herein, what is consciousness also conditioned by name? That which is mind, intellect, thought... the mind-consciousness element born of that—this is called "consciousness also conditioned by name."

Nāmapaccayā [P 0.0161] phassoti. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Ṭhapetvā phassaṃ, vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho saṅkhārakkhandho viññāṇakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “nāmaṃ”.

"With name as a condition, contact." Herein, what is name? Excluding contact, the feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, the formations aggregate, the consciousness aggregate—this is called "name."

Tattha katamo nāmapaccayā phasso? Yo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “nāmapaccayā phasso”[T 0.0215].

Herein, what is contact conditioned by name? Whatever is contact, contacting, thorough contacting, the state of contact—this is called "contact conditioned by name."

Tattha katamaṃ phassapaccayāpi nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho, viññāṇakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “phassapaccayāpi nāmaṃ”…pe… tena vuccati “evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī”ti.

Herein, what is name also conditioned by contact? The feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, the formations aggregate, the consciousness aggregate—this is called "name also conditioned by contact."... Therefore it is said: "Thus there is the arising of this entire mass of suffering."

276. Tasmiṃ samaye avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro, saṅkhārapaccayāpi avijjā; saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayāpi saṅkhāro; viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayāpi viññāṇaṃ; nāmarūpapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ, chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayāpi nāmarūpaṃ; chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā [V 0.0182] phasso, phassapaccayāpi chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ; phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayāpi phasso; vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayāpi vedanā; taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayāpi taṇhā; upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

276. At that time, with ignorance as a condition, formations; with formations as a condition, also ignorance. With formations as a condition, consciousness; with consciousness as a condition, also formations. With consciousness as a condition, name-and-form; with name-and-form as a condition, also consciousness. With name-and-form as a condition, the sixth sense base; with the sixth sense base as a condition, also name-and-form. With the sixth sense base as a condition, contact; with contact as a condition, also the sixth sense base. With contact as a condition, feeling; with feeling as a condition, also contact. With feeling as a condition, craving; with craving as a condition, also feeling. With craving as a condition, clinging; with clinging as a condition, also craving. With clinging as a condition, becoming; with becoming as a condition, birth; with birth as a condition, aging-and-death. Thus there is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.

277. Tattha katamā avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjā”.

277. Herein, what is ignorance? Whatever is unknowing, not seeing... the bolt of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—this is called "ignorance."

Tattha katamo avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro.

Herein, what is the volitional formation conditioned by ignorance? Whatever is volition, thorough volition, the state of having willed—this is called 'the volitional formation conditioned by ignorance'.

Tattha [M 0.0168] katamā saṅkhārapaccayāpi avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “saṅkhārapaccayāpi avijjā”.

Herein, what is ignorance also conditioned by volitional formations? Whatever is not knowing, not seeing... the bolt of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—this is called 'ignorance also conditioned by volitional formations'.

Tattha katamaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ [T 0.0216] vuccati “saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ”.

Herein, what is consciousness conditioned by volitional formations? That which is mind, intellect, consciousness... the mind-consciousness element born of that—this is called 'consciousness conditioned by volitional formations'.

Tattha katamo viññāṇapaccayāpi saṅkhāro? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “viññāṇapaccayāpi saṅkhāro”.

Herein, what is the formation also conditioned by consciousness? Whatever is volition, thorough volition, the state of having volitionally intended—this is called 'the formation also conditioned by consciousness'.

Tattha katamaṃ viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ? Atthi nāmaṃ, atthi rūpaṃ. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “nāmaṃ”. Tattha katamaṃ rūpaṃ? Cakkhāyatanassa upacayo, sotāyatanassa upacayo, ghānāyatanassa upacayo, jivhāyatanassa upacayo[P 0.0162], kāyāyatanassa upacayo, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ cittajaṃ cittahetukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ – idaṃ vuccati “rūpaṃ”. Iti idañca nāmaṃ, idañca rūpaṃ. Idaṃ vuccati “viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ”.

Herein, what is name-and-form conditioned by consciousness? There is name, and there is form. Herein, what is name? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, and the aggregate of formations—this is called 'name.' Herein, what is form? The accumulation of the eye base, the accumulation of the ear base, the accumulation of the nose base, the accumulation of the tongue base, the accumulation of the body base, or whatever other form there is that is mind-born, mind-caused, mind-originated—this is called 'form.' Thus, this is name and this is form. This is called 'name-and-form conditioned by consciousness'.

Nāmarūpapaccayāpi viññāṇanti. Atthi nāmaṃ, atthi rūpaṃ. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho[V 0.0183], saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “nāmaṃ”. Tattha katamaṃ rūpaṃ? Yaṃ rūpaṃ nissāya manoviññāṇadhātu vattati – idaṃ vuccati “rūpaṃ”. Iti idañca nāmaṃ, idañca rūpaṃ. Idaṃ vuccati “nāmarūpaṃ”.

Consciousness also, with name-and-form as condition. There is name, and there is form. Herein, what is name? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, and the aggregate of formations—this is called 'name.' Herein, what is form? That form depending on which the mind-consciousness element occurs—this is called 'form.' Thus, this is name and this is form. This is called 'name-and-form'.

Tattha katamaṃ nāmarūpapaccayāpi viññāṇaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “nāmarūpapaccayāpi viññāṇaṃ”.

Herein, what is consciousness also conditioned by name-and-form? Whatever is mind, intellect, consciousness... the mind-consciousness element born of that—this is called 'consciousness also conditioned by name-and-form'.

Nāmarūpapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatananti. Atthi nāmaṃ, atthi rūpaṃ. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “nāmaṃ”. Tattha katamaṃ rūpaṃ? Yaṃ rūpaṃ nissāya manoviññāṇadhātu vattati – idaṃ vuccati “rūpaṃ”. Iti idañca nāmaṃ, idañca rūpaṃ. Idaṃ vuccati “nāmarūpaṃ”.

The sixth sense base, with name-and-form as condition. There is name, and there is form. Herein, what is name? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, and the aggregate of formations—this is called 'name.' Herein, what is form? That form depending on which the mind-consciousness element occurs—this is called 'form.' Thus, this is name and this is form. This is called 'name-and-form'.

Tattha katamaṃ nāmarūpapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ [T 0.0217] vuccati “nāmarūpapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ”.

Herein, what is the sixth sense base conditioned by name-and-form? That which is mind, intellect, thought... the mind-consciousness element born of that—this is called "the sixth sense base conditioned by name-and-form."

Tattha katamaṃ chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayāpi nāmarūpaṃ? Atthi nāmaṃ, atthi rūpaṃ. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati [M 0.0169] “nāmaṃ”. Tattha katamaṃ rūpaṃ? Cakkhāyatanassa upacayo, sotāyatanassa upacayo, ghānāyatanassa upacayo, jivhāyatanassa upacayo, kāyāyatanassa upacayo, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ cittajaṃ cittahetukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ – idaṃ vuccati “rūpaṃ”. Iti idañca nāmaṃ, idañca rūpaṃ. Idaṃ vuccati “chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayāpi nāmarūpaṃ”.

Herein, what is name-and-form also conditioned by the sixth sense base? There is name, and there is form. Herein, what is name? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, and the aggregate of formations—this is called 'name.' Herein, what is form? The accumulation of the eye base, the accumulation of the ear base, the accumulation of the nose base, the accumulation of the tongue base, the accumulation of the body base, or whatever other form there is that is mind-born, mind-caused, mind-originated—this is called 'form.' Thus, this is name and this is form. This is called 'name-and-form also conditioned by the sixth sense base'.

Tattha katamo chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso? Yo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso”.

Herein, what is contact conditioned by the sixth sense base? Whatever is contact, the act of contacting, thorough contacting, the state of having thoroughly contacted—this is called 'contact conditioned by the sixth sense base'.

Tattha katamaṃ phassapaccayāpi chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “phassapaccayāpi chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ”…pe… tena vuccati “evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī”ti.

Herein, what is the sixth sense base also conditioned by contact? Whatever is mind, intellect, consciousness... and so on... the mind-consciousness element born of that—this is called 'the sixth sense base also conditioned by contact.'... and so on... Therefore it is said: 'Thus there is the origination of this entire mass of suffering'.

278. Tasmiṃ [P 0.0163][V 0.0184] samaye avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro, saṅkhārapaccayāpi avijjā; saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayāpi saṅkhāro; viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayāpi viññāṇaṃ; nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ, chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayāpi nāmarūpaṃ; chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayāpi chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ; phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayāpi phasso; vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayāpi vedanā; taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayāpi taṇhā; upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa [T 0.0218] samudayo hoti.

278. At that time, with ignorance as a condition, formations; with formations as a condition, also ignorance. With formations as a condition, consciousness; with consciousness as a condition, also formations. With consciousness as a condition, name-and-form; with name-and-form as a condition, also consciousness. With name-and-form as a condition, the sixfold sense base; with the sixth sense base as a condition, also name-and-form. With the sixth sense base as a condition, contact; with contact as a condition, also the sixth sense base. With contact as a condition, feeling; with feeling as a condition, also contact. With feeling as a condition, craving; with craving as a condition, also feeling. With craving as a condition, clinging; with clinging as a condition, also craving. With clinging as a condition, becoming; with becoming as a condition, birth; with birth as a condition, aging-and-death. Thus there is the arising of this entire mass of suffering.

279. Tattha katamā avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjā”.

279. Herein, what is ignorance? Whatever is unknowing, not seeing... and so on... the bolt of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—this is called 'ignorance'.

Tattha katamo avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro”.

Herein, what is the formation conditioned by ignorance? Whatever is volition, thorough volition, the state of having volitionally intended—this is called 'the formation conditioned by ignorance'.

Tattha katamā saṅkhārapaccayāpi avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “saṅkhārapaccayāpi avijjā”.

Herein, what is ignorance also conditioned by formations? Whatever is unknowing, not seeing... the bolt of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—this is called "ignorance also conditioned by formations."

Tattha katamaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ”.

Herein, what is consciousness conditioned by formations? That which is mind, intellect, thought... the mind-consciousness element born of that—this is called "consciousness conditioned by formations."

Tattha katamo viññāṇapaccayāpi saṅkhāro? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “viññāṇapaccayāpi saṅkhāro”.

Herein, what is the formation also conditioned by consciousness? Whatever is volition, intention, the state of intending—this is called "the formation also conditioned by consciousness."

Tattha [M 0.0170] katamaṃ viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ? Atthi nāmaṃ, atthi rūpaṃ. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati nāmaṃ. Tattha katamaṃ rūpaṃ? Cakkhāyatanassa upacayo, sotāyatanassa upacayo, ghānāyatanassa upacayo, jivhāyatanassa upacayo, kāyāyatanassa upacayo, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ cittajaṃ cittahetukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [V 0.0185] – idaṃ vuccati “rūpaṃ”. Iti idañca nāmaṃ, idañca rūpaṃ. Idaṃ vuccati “viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ”.

Herein, what is name-and-form conditioned by consciousness? There is name, and there is form. Herein, what is name? The feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, the formations aggregate—this is called "name." Herein, what is form? The accumulation of the eye base, the accumulation of the ear base, the accumulation of the nose base, the accumulation of the tongue base, the accumulation of the body base, or whatever other form there is that is mind-born, mind-caused, mind-produced—this is called "form." Thus, this is name, and this is form. This is called "name-and-form conditioned by consciousness."

Nāmarūpapaccayāpi viññāṇanti. Atthi nāmaṃ, atthi rūpaṃ. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “nāmaṃ”. Tattha katamaṃ rūpaṃ? Yaṃ rūpaṃ nissāya manoviññāṇadhātu vattati – idaṃ vuccati “rūpaṃ”. Iti idañca nāmaṃ, idañca rūpaṃ. Idaṃ [T 0.0219] vuccati “nāmarūpaṃ”.

"Consciousness is also conditioned by name-and-form." There is name, and there is form. Herein, what is name? The feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, the formations aggregate—this is called "name." Herein, what is form? Whatever form the mind-consciousness element depends on—this is called "form." Thus, this is name, and this is form. This is called "name-and-form."

Tattha [P 0.0164] katamaṃ nāmarūpapaccayāpi viññāṇaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “nāmarūpapaccayāpi viññāṇaṃ”.

Herein, what is consciousness also conditioned by name-and-form? That which is mind, intellect, thought... the mind-consciousness element born of that—this is called "consciousness also conditioned by name-and-form."

Nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatananti. Atthi nāmaṃ, atthi rūpaṃ. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “nāmaṃ”. Tattha katamaṃ rūpaṃ? Cattāro ca mahābhūtā, yañca rūpaṃ nissāya manoviññāṇadhātu vattati – idaṃ vuccati “rūpaṃ”. Iti idañca nāmaṃ, idañca rūpaṃ. Idaṃ vuccati “nāmarūpaṃ”.

Regarding 'With name-and-form as condition, the six sense bases.' There is name, there is form. Therein, what is name? The feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, the formations aggregate—this is called 'name.' Therein, what is form? The four great elements and whatever form depending on which the mind-consciousness element occurs—this is called 'form.' Thus, this is name and this is form. This is called 'name-and-form.'

Tattha katamaṃ nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ, sotāyatanaṃ, ghānāyatanaṃ, jivhāyatanaṃ, kāyāyatanaṃ, manāyatanaṃ – idaṃ vuccati “nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ”.

Therein, what are the six sense bases with name-and-form as condition? The eye base, the ear base, the nose base, the tongue base, the body base, the mind base—this is called 'the six sense bases with name-and-form as condition.'

Tattha katamaṃ chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayāpi nāmarūpaṃ? Atthi nāmaṃ, atthi rūpaṃ. Tattha katamaṃ nāmaṃ? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho – idaṃ vuccati “nāmaṃ”. Tattha katamaṃ rūpaṃ? Cakkhāyatanassa upacayo, sotāyatanassa upacayo, ghānāyatanassa upacayo, jivhāyatanassa upacayo, kāyāyatanassa upacayo, yaṃ vā panaññampi atthi rūpaṃ cittajaṃ cittahetukaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ – idaṃ vuccati “rūpaṃ”. Iti idañca nāmaṃ, idañca rūpaṃ. Idaṃ vuccati “chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayāpi nāmarūpaṃ”.

Therein, what is name-and-form also with the sixth sense base as condition? There is name, there is form. Therein, what is name? The feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, the formations aggregate—this is called 'name.' Therein, what is form? The accumulation of the eye base, the accumulation of the ear base, the accumulation of the nose base, the accumulation of the tongue base, the accumulation of the body base, or whatever other form there is that is mind-born, mind-caused, and mind-originated—this is called 'form.' Thus, this is name and this is form. This is called 'name-and-form also with the sixth sense base as condition.'

Tattha katamo chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso? Yo phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso”.

Therein, what is contact with the sixth sense base as condition? Whatever is contact, touching, impingement, the state of having touched—this is called 'contact with the sixth sense base as condition.'

Tattha [M 0.0171][V 0.0186] katamaṃ phassapaccayāpi chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ? Yaṃ cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ…pe… tajjāmanoviññāṇadhātu – idaṃ vuccati “phassapaccayāpi chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ”.

Therein, what is the sixth sense base also with contact as condition? Whatever is mind, intellect, consciousness... and so on... the corresponding mind-consciousness element—this is called 'the sixth sense base also with contact as condition.'

Tattha katamā phassapaccayā vedanā? Yaṃ cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā – ayaṃ vuccati “phassapaccayā vedanā”…pe… tena vuccati “evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī”ti.

Therein, what is feeling with contact as condition? Whatever is mental pleasantness, mental happiness; a pleasant, happy experience born of mind-contact; a pleasant, happy feeling born of mind-contact—this is called 'feeling with contact as condition.' ... and so on ... Therefore, it is said: 'Thus is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.'

Aññamaññacatukkaṃ.

The Mutual Quatrain.

9. Akusalaniddeso

9. Exposition of the Unwholesome

280. Katame [T 0.0220] dhammā akusalā? Yasmiṃ samaye akusalaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ hoti somanassasahagataṃ diṭṭhigatasampayuttaṃ sasaṅkhārena…pe… somanassasahagataṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ rūpārammaṇaṃ vā…pe… somanassasahagataṃ [P 0.0165] diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ sasaṅkhārena rūpārammaṇaṃ vā saddārammaṇaṃ vā gandhārammaṇaṃ vā rasārammaṇaṃ vā phoṭṭhabbārammaṇaṃ vā dhammārammaṇaṃ vā yaṃ yaṃ vā panārabbha, tasmiṃ samaye avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ, nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ, chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā adhimokkho, adhimokkhapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

280. Which states are unwholesome? At the time when an unwholesome consciousness arises, accompanied by joy, associated with wrong view, with prompting... or accompanied by joy, dissociated from wrong view, having a visible object as object... or accompanied by joy, dissociated from wrong view, with prompting, having as object a visible object, or a sound, or an odor, or a taste, or a tangible object, or a mental object, or whatever it may be; at that time, with ignorance as condition, a formation arises; with formation as condition, consciousness arises; with consciousness as condition, name arises; with name as condition, the sixth sense base arises; with the sixth sense base as condition, contact arises; with contact as condition, feeling arises; with feeling as condition, craving arises; with craving as condition, determination arises; with determination as condition, becoming arises; with becoming as condition, birth arises; with birth as condition, aging and death arise. Thus is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

281. Tattha katamā avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati “avijjā”.

281. Therein, what is ignorance? Whatever is non-knowing, non-seeing... the bolt of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—this is called 'ignorance'.

Tattha katamo avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro? Yā cetanā sañcetanā sañcetayitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro…pe….

Therein, what is the formation with ignorance as condition? Whatever is volition, the act of willing, the state of having willed—this is called 'formation with ignorance as condition.' ... and so on.

Tattha [V 0.0187] katamo taṇhāpaccayā adhimokkho? Yo cittassa adhimokkho adhimuccanā tadadhimuttatā – ayaṃ vuccati “taṇhāpaccayā adhimokkho”.

Therein, what is determination conditioned by craving? Whatever is the mind's determination, the act of determining, the state of having determined on that—this is called 'determination conditioned by craving'.

Tattha katamo adhimokkhapaccayā bhavo? Ṭhapetvā adhimokkhaṃ, vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho saṅkhārakkhandho viññāṇakkhandho – ayaṃ vuccati “adhimokkhapaccayā [M 0.0172] bhavo”…pe… tena vuccati “evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī”ti.

Therein, what is becoming conditioned by determination? Excluding determination, the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of formations, and the aggregate of consciousness—this is called 'becoming conditioned by determination'... and so on. Therefore, it is said: 'Thus is the origin of this entire mass of suffering'.

282. Katame [T 0.0221] dhammā akusalā? Yasmiṃ samaye akusalaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ hoti upekkhāsahagataṃ diṭṭhigatasampayuttaṃ rūpārammaṇaṃ vā saddārammaṇaṃ vā gandhārammaṇaṃ vā rasārammaṇaṃ vā phoṭṭhabbārammaṇaṃ vā dhammārammaṇaṃ vā yaṃ yaṃ vā panārabbha, tasmiṃ samaye avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ, nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ, chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

282. Which states are unwholesome? At the time when an unwholesome consciousness arises, accompanied by equanimity, associated with wrong view, having as object a form, or a sound, or an odor, or a taste, or a tangible object, or a mental object, or whatever it may be; at that time, conditioned by ignorance, formation arises; conditioned by formation, consciousness arises; conditioned by consciousness, mentality arises; conditioned by mentality, the sixth sense base arises; conditioned by the sixth sense base, contact arises; conditioned by contact, feeling arises; conditioned by feeling, craving arises; conditioned by craving, clinging arises; conditioned by clinging, becoming arises; conditioned by becoming, birth arises; conditioned by birth, aging and death arise. Thus is the origin of this entire mass of suffering.

283. Tattha [P 0.0166] katamā avijjā? Yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ…pe… avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati avijjā…pe….

283. Therein, what is ignorance? Whatever is not-knowing, not-seeing... the bolt of ignorance, delusion, the unwholesome root—this is called 'ignorance'... and so on.

Tattha katamā phassapaccayā vedanā? Yaṃ cetasikaṃ neva sātaṃ nāsātaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ adukkhamasukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā adukkhamasukhā vedanā – ayaṃ vuccati “phassapaccayā vedanā”…pe… tena vuccati “evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī”ti.

Therein, what is feeling conditioned by contact? Whatever is mental, neither pleasant nor unpleasant; born of mental contact, that which is felt as neither-painful-nor-pleasant; born of mental contact, the neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling—this is called 'feeling conditioned by contact'... and so on. Therefore, it is said: 'Thus is the origin of this entire mass of suffering'.

284. Katame dhammā akusalā? Yasmiṃ samaye akusalaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ hoti upekkhāsahagataṃ diṭṭhigatasampayuttaṃ sasaṅkhārena…pe… upekkhāsahagataṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ rūpārammaṇaṃ vā…pe… upekkhāsahagataṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttaṃ sasaṅkhārena rūpārammaṇaṃ vā saddārammaṇaṃ vā gandhārammaṇaṃ vā rasārammaṇaṃ vā phoṭṭhabbārammaṇaṃ vā dhammārammaṇaṃ vā yaṃ yaṃ vā panārabbha, tasmiṃ samaye avijjāpaccayā saṅkhāro, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmaṃ, nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ[T 0.0222], chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā[V 0.0188], taṇhāpaccayā adhimokkho, adhimokkhapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ. Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

284. Which states are unwholesome?
