Cha phassā na arūpadhātupariyāpannā; manoviññāṇadhātusamphasso siyā arūpadhātupariyāpanno, siyā na arūpadhātupariyāpanno.

Six contacts are not included in the immaterial realm; contact of the mind-consciousness element is sometimes included in the immaterial realm, and sometimes not included in the immaterial realm.

Cha vedanā…pe… cha saññā [T 0.0553]… cha cetanā… cha cittā na arūpadhātupariyāpannā; manoviññāṇadhātu siyā arūpadhātupariyāpannā, siyā na arūpadhātupariyāpannā.

Six feelings…pe… six perceptions… six volitions… six consciousnesses are not included in the immaterial realm; the mind-consciousness element is sometimes included in the immaterial realm, and sometimes not included in the immaterial realm.

4. Pariyāpannāpariyāpannaṃ

4. Included and Not Included

1005. Pañcannaṃ [M 0.0426] khandhānaṃ kati pariyāpannā, kati apariyāpannā…pe… sattannaṃ cittānaṃ kati pariyāpannā, kati apariyāpannā?

1005. Of the five aggregates, how many are included, how many are not included?…pe… Of the seven consciousnesses, how many are included, how many are not included?

1006. Rūpakkhandho pariyāpanno; cattāro khandhā siyā pariyāpannā, siyā apariyāpannā.

1006. The form aggregate is included; the four aggregates are sometimes included, and sometimes not included.

Dasāyatanā pariyāpannā; dve āyatanā siyā pariyāpannā, siyā apariyāpannā.

Ten bases are included; two bases are sometimes included, and sometimes not included.

Soḷasa dhātuyo pariyāpannā; dve dhātuyo siyā pariyāpannā, siyā apariyāpannā.

Sixteen elements are included; two elements are sometimes included, and sometimes not included.

Dve saccā pariyāpannā; dve saccā apariyāpannā.

Two truths are included; two truths are not included.

Dasindriyā pariyāpannā, tīṇindriyā apariyāpannā; navindriyā siyā pariyāpannā, siyā apariyāpannā.

Ten faculties are included, three faculties are not included; nine faculties are sometimes included, and sometimes not included.

Tayo akusalahetū pariyāpannā; cha hetū siyā pariyāpannā, siyā apariyāpannā.

The three unwholesome roots are included; six roots are sometimes included, and sometimes not included.

Kabaḷīkāro [V 0.0483] āhāro pariyāpanno; tayo āhārā siyā pariyāpannā, siyā apariyāpannā.

Physical nutriment is included; three nutriments are sometimes included, and sometimes not included.

Cha phassā pariyāpannā; manoviññāṇadhātusamphasso siyā pariyāpanno, siyā apariyāpanno.

Six contacts are included; contact of the mind-consciousness element is sometimes included, and sometimes not included.

Cha vedanā…pe… cha saññā… cha cetanā… cha cittā pariyāpannā; manoviññāṇadhātu siyā pariyāpannā, siyā apariyāpannā.

Six feelings…pe… six perceptions… six volitions… six consciousnesses are included; the mind-consciousness element is sometimes included, and sometimes not included.

4. Dhammadassanavāro

4. The Section on the Exposition of Phenomena

1. Kāmadhātu

1. The Sensuous Sphere

1007. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kati khandhā pātubhavanti…pe… kati cittāni pātubhavanti?

1007. At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, how many aggregates arise?…pe… how many consciousnesses arise?

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe sabbesaṃ [T 0.0554] pañcakkhandhā pātubhavanti; kassaci ekādasāyatanāni pātubhavanti; kassaci [P 0.0412] dasāyatanāni pātubhavanti; kassaci [M 0.0427] aparāni dasāyatanāni pātubhavanti; kassaci navāyatanāni pātubhavanti; kassaci sattāyatanāni pātubhavanti; kassaci ekādasa dhātuyo pātubhavanti; kassaci dasa dhātuyo pātubhavanti; kassaci aparā dasa dhātuyo pātubhavanti; kassaci nava dhātuyo pātubhavanti; kassaci satta dhātuyo pātubhavanti; sabbesaṃ ekaṃ saccaṃ pātubhavati; kassaci cuddasindriyāni pātubhavanti; kassaci terasindriyāni pātubhavanti; kassaci aparāni terasindriyāni pātubhavanti; kassaci dvādasindriyāni pātubhavanti; kassaci dasindriyāni pātubhavanti; kassaci navindriyāni pātubhavanti; kassaci aparāni navindriyāni pātubhavanti; kassaci aṭṭhindriyāni pātubhavanti; kassaci aparāni aṭṭhindriyāni pātubhavanti; kassaci sattindriyāni pātubhavanti; kassaci pañcindriyāni pātubhavanti; kassaci cattārindriyāni pātubhavanti; kassaci tayo hetū pātubhavanti; kassaci dve hetū pātubhavanti; kassaci keci (syā.) ahetukā pātubhavanti[V 0.0484]; sabbesaṃ cattāro āhārā pātubhavanti; sabbesaṃ eko phasso pātubhavati; sabbesaṃ ekā vedanā… ekā saññā… ekā cetanā… ekaṃ cittaṃ pātubhavati.

At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, for all, the five aggregates arise. For some, eleven bases arise; for some, ten bases arise; for some, another ten bases arise; for some, nine bases arise; for some, seven bases arise. For some, eleven elements arise; for some, ten elements arise; for some, another ten elements arise; for some, nine elements arise; for some, seven elements arise. For all, one truth arises. For some, fourteen faculties arise; for some, thirteen faculties arise; for some, another thirteen faculties arise; for some, twelve faculties arise; for some, ten faculties arise; for some, nine faculties arise; for some, another nine faculties arise; for some, eight faculties arise; for some, another eight faculties arise; for some, seven faculties arise; for some, five faculties arise; for some, four faculties arise. For some, three roots arise; for some, two roots arise; for some, rootless conditions arise. For all, four nutriments arise. For all, one contact arises; for all, one feeling… one perception… one volition… one consciousness arises.

1008. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe sabbesaṃ katame pañcakkhandhā pātubhavanti? Rūpakkhandho…pe… viññāṇakkhandho – kāmadhātuyā [T 0.0555] upapattikkhaṇe sabbesaṃ ime pañcakkhandhā pātubhavanti.

1008. At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, which five aggregates arise for all? The aggregate of form…pe… the aggregate of consciousness—at the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, these five aggregates arise for all.

1009. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa ekādasāyatanāni pātubhavanti? Kāmāvacarānaṃ devānaṃ, paṭhamakappikānaṃ manussānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ petānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ asurānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ tiracchānagatānaṃ, nerayikānaṃ paripuṇṇāyatanānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe ekādasāyatanāni pātubhavanti – cakkhāyatanaṃ, rūpāyatanaṃ, sotāyatanaṃ, ghānāyatanaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ, jivhāyatanaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ, kāyāyatanaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, manāyatanaṃ, dhammāyatanaṃ. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imāni ekādasāyatanāni pātubhavanti.

1009. At the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, for whom do eleven bases arise? For the sensuous-sphere devas, humans of the first aeon, spontaneously born ghosts, spontaneously born asuras, spontaneously born animals, and hell-beings, who have complete bases, at the moment of rebirth eleven bases arise: the eye-base, form-base, ear-base, nose-base, odor-base, tongue-base, taste-base, body-base, tangible-object-base, mind-base, and dhamma-base. At the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, these eleven bases arise for them.

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa dasāyatanāni pātubhavanti? Opapātikānaṃ petānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ asurānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ tiracchānagatānaṃ nerayikānaṃ, jaccandhānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe dasāyatanāni pātubhavanti [M 0.0428] – rūpāyatanaṃ, sotāyatanaṃ, ghānāyatanaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ, jivhāyatanaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ[P 0.0413], kāyāyatanaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, manāyatanaṃ, dhammāyatanaṃ. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imāni dasāyatanāni pātubhavanti.

At the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, for whom do ten bases arise? For spontaneously born ghosts, spontaneously born asuras, spontaneously born animals, hell-beings, and the congenitally blind, at the moment of rebirth ten bases arise: the form-base, ear-base, nose-base, odor-base, tongue-base, taste-base, body-base, tangible-object-base, mind-base, and dhamma-base. At the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, these ten bases arise for them.

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa aparāni dasāyatanāni pātubhavanti? Opapātikānaṃ petānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ asurānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ tiracchānagatānaṃ nerayikānaṃ, jaccabadhirānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe dasāyatanāni pātubhavanti – cakkhāyatanaṃ, rūpāyatanaṃ, ghānāyatanaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ, jivhāyatanaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ, kāyāyatanaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, manāyatanaṃ, dhammāyatanaṃ. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imāni dasāyatanāni [T 0.0556] pātubhavanti.

At the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, for whom do another ten bases arise? For spontaneously born ghosts, spontaneously born asuras, spontaneously born animals, hell-beings, and the congenitally deaf, at the moment of rebirth ten bases arise: the eye-base, form-base, nose-base, odor-base, tongue-base, taste-base, body-base, tangible-object-base, mind-base, and dhamma-base. At the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, these ten bases arise for them.

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa navāyatanāni pātubhavanti? Opapātikānaṃ petānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ asurānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ tiracchānagatānaṃ nerayikānaṃ, jaccandhabadhirānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe [V 0.0485] navāyatanāni pātubhavanti – rūpāyatanaṃ, ghānāyatanaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ, jivhāyatanaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ, kāyāyatanaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, manāyatanaṃ, dhammāyatanaṃ. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imāni navāyatanāni pātubhavanti.

At the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, for whom do nine bases arise? For spontaneously born ghosts, spontaneously born asuras, spontaneously born animals, hell-beings, and the congenitally blind and deaf, at the moment of rebirth nine bases arise: the form-base, nose-base, odor-base, tongue-base, taste-base, body-base, tangible-object-base, mind-base, and dhamma-base. At the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, these nine bases arise for them.

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa sattāyatanāni pātubhavanti? Gabbhaseyyakānaṃ sattānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe sattāyatanāni pātubhavanti – rūpāyatanaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ, kāyāyatanaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, manāyatanaṃ, dhammāyatanaṃ. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imāni sattāyatanāni pātubhavanti.

At the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, for whom do seven bases arise? For womb-born beings, at the moment of rebirth seven bases arise: the form-base, odor-base, taste-base, body-base, tangible-object-base, mind-base, and dhamma-base. At the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, these seven bases arise for them.

1010. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa ekādasa dhātuyo pātubhavanti? Kāmāvacarānaṃ devānaṃ, paṭhamakappikānaṃ manussānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ petānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ asurānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ tiracchānagatānaṃ nerayikānaṃ paripuṇṇāyatanānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe ekādasa dhātuyo pātubhavanti – cakkhudhātu, rūpadhātu, sotadhātu, ghānadhātu, gandhadhātu, jivhādhātu, rasadhātu, kāyadhātu, phoṭṭhabbadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu, dhammadhātu. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imā ekādasa dhātuyo pātubhavanti.

1010. At the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, for whom do eleven elements arise? For the sensuous-sphere devas, humans of the first aeon, spontaneously born ghosts, spontaneously born asuras, spontaneously born animals, and hell-beings, who have complete bases, at the moment of rebirth eleven elements arise: the eye-element, form-element, ear-element, nose-element, odor-element, tongue-element, taste-element, body-element, tangible-object-element, mind-consciousness-element, and dhamma-element. At the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, these eleven elements arise for them.

Kāmadhātuyā [M 0.0429] upapattikkhaṇe kassa dasa dhātuyo pātubhavanti? Opapātikānaṃ petānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ asurānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ [P 0.0414] tiracchānagatānaṃ nerayikānaṃ[T 0.0557], jaccandhānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe dasa dhātuyo pātubhavanti – rūpadhātu, sotadhātu, ghānadhātu, gandhadhātu, jivhādhātu, rasadhātu, kāyadhātu, phoṭṭhabbadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu, dhammadhātu. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imā dasa dhātuyo pātubhavanti.

At the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, for whom do ten elements arise? For spontaneously born ghosts, spontaneously born asuras, spontaneously born animals, hell-beings, and the congenitally blind, at the moment of rebirth ten elements arise: the form-element, ear-element, nose-element, odor-element, tongue-element, taste-element, body-element, tangible-object-element, mind-consciousness-element, and dhamma-element. At the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, these ten elements arise for them.

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa aparā dasa dhātuyo pātubhavanti? Opapātikānaṃ petānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ asurānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ tiracchānagatānaṃ nerayikānaṃ, jaccabadhirānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe dasa dhātuyo pātubhavanti – cakkhudhātu, rūpadhātu, ghānadhātu, gandhadhātu, jivhādhātu, rasadhātu, kāyadhātu, phoṭṭhabbadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu, dhammadhātu. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imā dasa dhātuyo pātubhavanti.

At the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, for whom do another ten elements arise? For spontaneously born ghosts, spontaneously born asuras, spontaneously born animals, hell-beings, and the congenitally deaf, at the moment of rebirth ten elements arise: the eye-element, form-element, nose-element, odor-element, tongue-element, taste-element, body-element, tangible-object-element, mind-consciousness-element, and dhamma-element. At the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, these ten elements arise for them.

Kāmadhātuyā [V 0.0486] upapattikkhaṇe kassa nava dhātuyo pātubhavanti? Opapātikānaṃ petānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ asurānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ tiracchānagatānaṃ nerayikānaṃ, jaccandhabadhirānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe nava dhātuyo pātubhavanti – rūpadhātu, ghānadhātu, gandhadhātu, jivhādhātu, rasadhātu, kāyadhātu, phoṭṭhabbadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu, dhammadhātu. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imā nava dhātuyo pātubhavanti.

At the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, for whom do nine elements arise? For spontaneously born ghosts, spontaneously born asuras, spontaneously born animals, hell-beings, and the congenitally blind and deaf, at the moment of rebirth nine elements arise: the form-element, nose-element, odor-element, tongue-element, taste-element, body-element, tangible-object-element, mind-consciousness-element, and dhamma-element. At the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere, these nine elements arise for them.

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa satta dhātuyo pātubhavanti? Gabbhaseyyakānaṃ sattānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe satta dhātuyo pātubhavanti – rūpadhātu, gandhadhātu, rasadhātu, kāyadhātu, phoṭṭhabbadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu, dhammadhātu. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imā satta dhātuyo pātubhavanti.

At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, for whom do seven elements arise? For womb-born beings, at the moment of rebirth seven elements arise: the form element, odor element, taste element, body element, tangible object element, mind-consciousness element, and mental-object element. At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, these seven elements arise for them.

1011. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe [T 0.0558] sabbesaṃ katamaṃ ekaṃ saccaṃ pātubhavati? Dukkhasaccaṃ – kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe sabbesaṃ idaṃ ekaṃ saccaṃ pātubhavati.

1011. At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, which one truth arises for all? The truth of suffering. At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, this one truth arises for all.

1012. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa cuddasindriyāni pātubhavanti? Kāmāvacarānaṃ devānaṃ, sahetukānaṃ ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe cuddasindriyāni pātubhavanti – cakkhundriyaṃ, sotindriyaṃ, ghānindriyaṃ, jivhindriyaṃ, kāyindriyaṃ[M 0.0430][P 0.0415], manindriyaṃ, itthindriyaṃ vā purisindriyaṃ vā, jīvitindriyaṃ, somanassindriyaṃ vā upekkhindriyaṃ vā, saddhindriyaṃ, vīriyindriyaṃ, satindriyaṃ, samādhindriyaṃ, paññindriyaṃ. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imāni cuddasindriyāni pātubhavanti.

1012. At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, for whom do fourteen faculties arise? For sensuous-sphere devas who are rooted and associated with knowledge, at the moment of rebirth fourteen faculties arise: the eye faculty, ear faculty, nose faculty, tongue faculty, body faculty, mind faculty, female faculty or male faculty, life faculty, faculty of joy or faculty of equanimity, faith faculty, energy faculty, mindfulness faculty, concentration faculty, and wisdom faculty. At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, these fourteen faculties arise for them.

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa terasindriyāni pātubhavanti? Kāmāvacarānaṃ devānaṃ sahetukānaṃ ñāṇavippayuttānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe terasindriyāni pātubhavanti – cakkhundriyaṃ, sotindriyaṃ, ghānindriyaṃ, jivhindriyaṃ, kāyindriyaṃ, manindriyaṃ, itthindriyaṃ vā purisindriyaṃ vā, jīvitindriyaṃ, somanassindriyaṃ vā upekkhindriyaṃ vā, saddhindriyaṃ, vīriyindriyaṃ, satindriyaṃ, samādhindriyaṃ. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imāni terasindriyāni pātubhavanti.

At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, for whom do thirteen faculties arise? For sensuous-sphere devas who are rooted and dissociated from knowledge, at the moment of rebirth thirteen faculties arise: the eye faculty, ear faculty, nose faculty, tongue faculty, body faculty, mind faculty, female faculty or male faculty, life faculty, faculty of joy or faculty of equanimity, faith faculty, energy faculty, mindfulness faculty, and concentration faculty. At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, these thirteen faculties arise for them.

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa aparāni terasindriyāni pātubhavanti? Paṭhamakappikānaṃ [V 0.0487] manussānaṃ sahetukānaṃ ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe terasindriyāni pātubhavanti – cakkhundriyaṃ, sotindriyaṃ, ghānindriyaṃ, jivhindriyaṃ, kāyindriyaṃ, manindriyaṃ, jīvitindriyaṃ, somanassindriyaṃ vā upekkhindriyaṃ vā, saddhindriyaṃ[T 0.0559], vīriyindriyaṃ, satindriyaṃ, samādhindriyaṃ, paññindriyaṃ. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imāni terasindriyāni pātubhavanti.

At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, for whom do another thirteen faculties arise? For humans of the first aeon who are rooted and associated with knowledge, at the moment of rebirth thirteen faculties arise: the eye faculty, ear faculty, nose faculty, tongue faculty, body faculty, mind faculty, life faculty, faculty of joy or faculty of equanimity, faith faculty, energy faculty, mindfulness faculty, concentration faculty, and wisdom faculty. At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, these thirteen faculties arise for them.

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa dvādasindriyāni pātubhavanti? Paṭhamakappikānaṃ manussānaṃ sahetukānaṃ ñāṇavippayuttānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe dvādasindriyāni pātubhavanti – cakkhundriyaṃ, sotindriyaṃ, ghānindriyaṃ, jivhindriyaṃ, kāyindriyaṃ, manindriyaṃ, jīvitindriyaṃ, somanassindriyaṃ vā upekkhindriyaṃ vā, saddhindriyaṃ, vīriyindriyaṃ, satindriyaṃ, samādhindriyaṃ. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imāni dvādasindriyāni pātubhavanti.

At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, for whom do twelve faculties arise? For humans of the first aeon who are rooted and dissociated from knowledge, at the moment of rebirth twelve faculties arise: the eye faculty, ear faculty, nose faculty, tongue faculty, body faculty, mind faculty, life faculty, faculty of joy or faculty of equanimity, faith faculty, energy faculty, mindfulness faculty, and concentration faculty. At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, these twelve faculties arise for them.

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa dasindriyāni pātubhavanti? Gabbhaseyyakānaṃ sattānaṃ sahetukānaṃ ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe dasindriyāni pātubhavanti – kāyindriyaṃ, manindriyaṃ, itthindriyaṃ vā purisindriyaṃ vā, jīvitindriyaṃ, somanassindriyaṃ vā upekkhindriyaṃ vā, saddhindriyaṃ, vīriyindriyaṃ, satindriyaṃ, samādhindriyaṃ, paññindriyaṃ. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imāni dasindriyāni pātubhavanti.

At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, for whom do ten faculties arise? For womb-born beings who are rooted and associated with knowledge, at the moment of rebirth ten faculties arise: the body faculty, mind faculty, female faculty or male faculty, life faculty, faculty of joy or faculty of equanimity, faith faculty, energy faculty, mindfulness faculty, concentration faculty, and wisdom faculty. At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, these ten faculties arise for them.

Kāmadhātuyā [P 0.0416] upapattikkhaṇe kassa navindriyāni pātubhavanti? Gabbhaseyyakānaṃ sattānaṃ sahetukānaṃ ñāṇavippayuttānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe navindriyāni [M 0.0431] pātubhavanti – kāyindriyaṃ, manindriyaṃ, itthindriyaṃ vā purisindriyaṃ vā, jīvitindriyaṃ, somanassindriyaṃ vā upekkhindriyaṃ vā, saddhindriyaṃ, vīriyindriyaṃ, satindriyaṃ, samādhindriyaṃ. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imāni navindriyāni pātubhavanti.

At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, for whom do nine faculties arise? For womb-born beings who are rooted and dissociated from knowledge, at the moment of rebirth nine faculties arise: the body faculty, mind faculty, female faculty or male faculty, life faculty, faculty of joy or faculty of equanimity, faith faculty, energy faculty, mindfulness faculty, and concentration faculty. At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, these nine faculties arise for them.

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe [T 0.0560] kassa aparāni navindriyāni pātubhavanti? Opapātikānaṃ petānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ asurānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ tiracchānagatānaṃ nerayikānaṃ paripuṇṇāyatanānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe navindriyāni pātubhavanti – cakkhundriyaṃ, sotindriyaṃ, ghānindriyaṃ, jivhindriyaṃ, kāyindriyaṃ, manindriyaṃ, itthindriyaṃ vā purisindriyaṃ vā, jīvitindriyaṃ[V 0.0488], upekkhindriyaṃ. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imāni navindriyāni pātubhavanti.

At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, for whom do another nine faculties arise? For spontaneously arisen petas, spontaneously arisen asuras, spontaneously arisen animals, and hell-beings with complete sense bases, at the moment of rebirth nine faculties arise: the eye faculty, ear faculty, nose faculty, tongue faculty, body faculty, mind faculty, female faculty or male faculty, life faculty, and equanimity faculty. At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, these nine faculties arise for them.

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa aṭṭhindriyāni pātubhavanti? Opapātikānaṃ petānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ asurānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ tiracchānagatānaṃ nerayikānaṃ, jaccandhānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe aṭṭhindriyāni pātubhavanti – sotindriyaṃ, ghānindriyaṃ, jivhindriyaṃ, kāyindriyaṃ, manindriyaṃ, itthindriyaṃ vā purisindriyaṃ vā, jīvitindriyaṃ, upekkhindriyaṃ. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imāni aṭṭhindriyāni pātubhavanti.

At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, for whom do eight faculties arise? For spontaneously arisen petas, spontaneously arisen asuras, spontaneously arisen animals, hell-beings, and the congenitally blind, at the moment of rebirth eight faculties arise: the ear faculty, nose faculty, tongue faculty, body faculty, mind faculty, female faculty or male faculty, life faculty, and equanimity faculty. At the moment of rebirth in the sensuous sphere, these eight faculties arise for them.

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa aparāni aṭṭhindriyāni pātubhavanti? Opapātikānaṃ petānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ asurānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ tiracchānagatānaṃ nerayikānaṃ, jaccabadhirānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe aṭṭhindriyāni pātubhavanti – cakkhundriyaṃ, ghānindriyaṃ, jivhindriyaṃ, kāyindriyaṃ manindriyaṃ, itthindriyaṃ vā purisindriyaṃ vā, jīvitindriyaṃ, upekkhindriyaṃ. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imāni aṭṭhindriyāni pātubhavanti.

In the sense-sphere realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, for which beings do another eight faculties arise? For spontaneously arisen petas, spontaneously arisen asuras, spontaneously arisen animals, and spontaneously arisen hell-beings, and for the congenitally deaf, at the moment of rebirth-linking, eight faculties arise: the eye faculty, the nose faculty, the tongue faculty, the body faculty, the mind faculty, the female faculty or the male faculty, the life faculty, and the equanimity faculty. In the sense-sphere realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, for these beings, these eight faculties arise.

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa sattindriyāni pātubhavanti? Opapātikānaṃ petānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ asurānaṃ, opapātikānaṃ tiracchānagatānaṃ nerayikānaṃ, jaccandhabadhirānaṃ [T 0.0561] upapattikkhaṇe sattindriyāni pātubhavanti – ghānindriyaṃ[P 0.0417], jivhindriyaṃ, kāyindriyaṃ, manindriyaṃ, itthindriyaṃ vā purisindriyaṃ vā, jīvitindriyaṃ, upekkhindriyaṃ. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imāni sattindriyāni pātubhavanti.

In the sense-sphere realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, for which beings do seven faculties arise? For spontaneously arisen petas, spontaneously arisen asuras, spontaneously arisen animals, and spontaneously arisen hell-beings, and for the congenitally blind and deaf, at the moment of rebirth-linking, seven faculties arise: the nose faculty, the tongue faculty, the body faculty, the mind faculty, the female faculty or the male faculty, the life faculty, and the equanimity faculty. In the sense-sphere realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, for these beings, these seven faculties arise.

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa pañcindriyāni pātubhavanti? Gabbhaseyyakānaṃ sattānaṃ ahetukānaṃ, ṭhapetvā napuṃsakānaṃ, upapattikkhaṇe pañcindriyāni [M 0.0432] pātubhavanti – kāyindriyaṃ, manindriyaṃ, itthindriyaṃ vā purisindriyaṃ vā, jīvitindriyaṃ, upekkhindriyaṃ. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imāni pañcindriyāni pātubhavanti.

In the sense-sphere realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, for which beings do five faculties arise? For rootless, womb-born beings, excluding the neuter ones, at the moment of rebirth-linking, five faculties arise: the body faculty, the mind faculty, the female faculty or the male faculty, the life faculty, and the equanimity faculty. In the sense-sphere realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, for these beings, these five faculties arise.

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa cattārindriyāni pātubhavanti? Gabbhaseyyakānaṃ sattānaṃ ahetukānaṃ, napuṃsakānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe cattārindriyāni pātubhavanti – kāyindriyaṃ, manindriyaṃ, jīvitindriyaṃ[V 0.0489], upekkhindriyaṃ. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ imāni cattārindriyāni pātubhavanti.

In the sense-sphere realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, for which beings do four faculties arise? For rootless, neuter, womb-born beings, at the moment of rebirth-linking, four faculties arise: the body faculty, the mind faculty, the life faculty, and the equanimity faculty. In the sense-sphere realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, for these beings, these four faculties arise.

1013. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa tayo hetū pātubhavanti? Kāmāvacarānaṃ devānaṃ, paṭhamakappikānaṃ manussānaṃ, gabbhaseyyakānaṃ sattānaṃ sahetukānaṃ ñāṇasampayuttānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe tayo hetū pātubhavanti – alobho vipākahetu, adoso vipākahetu, amoho vipākahetu. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ ime tayo hetū pātubhavanti.

1013. In the sense-sphere realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, for which beings do three roots arise? For devas of the sense-sphere realm, for humans of the beginning of the aeon, and for womb-born beings who are accompanied by roots and associated with knowledge, at the moment of rebirth-linking, three roots arise: non-greed as a resultant root, non-hatred as a resultant root, and non-delusion as a resultant root. In the sense-sphere realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, for these beings, these three roots arise.

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe kassa dve hetū pātubhavanti? Kāmāvacarānaṃ devānaṃ, paṭhamakappikānaṃ manussānaṃ, gabbhaseyyakānaṃ sattānaṃ sahetukānaṃ ñāṇavippayuttānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe [T 0.0562] dve hetū pātubhavanti – alobho vipākahetu, adoso vipākahetu. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe etesaṃ ime dve hetū pātubhavanti. Avasesānaṃ sattānaṃ avasesā sattā (?) ahetukā pātubhavanti.

In the sense-sphere realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, for which beings do two roots arise? For devas of the sense-sphere realm, for humans of the beginning of the aeon, and for womb-born beings who are accompanied by roots and dissociated from knowledge, at the moment of rebirth-linking, two roots arise: non-greed as a resultant root and non-hatred as a resultant root. In the sense-sphere realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, for these beings, these two roots arise. For the remaining beings, rootless states arise.

1014. Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe sabbesaṃ katame cattāro āhārā pātubhavanti. Kabaḷīkāro āhāro, phassāhāro, manosañcetanāhāro, viññāṇāhāro – kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe sabbesaṃ ime cattāro āhārā pātubhavanti.

1014. In the sense-sphere realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, for all beings, which four nutriments arise? Physical food as nutriment, contact as nutriment, mental volition as nutriment, and consciousness as nutriment. In the sense-sphere realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, for all beings, these four nutriments arise.

Kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe sabbesaṃ katamo eko phasso pātubhavati? Manoviññāṇadhātusamphasso – kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe sabbesaṃ ayaṃ eko phasso pātubhavati.

In the sense-sphere realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, for all beings, which one contact arises? Contact of the mind-consciousness element. In the sense-sphere realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, for all beings, this one contact arises.

Kāmadhātuyā [M 0.0433] upapattikkhaṇe sabbesaṃ katamā ekā vedanā [P 0.0418]… ekā saññā… ekā cetanā… ekaṃ cittaṃ pātubhavati? Manoviññāṇadhātu – kāmadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe sabbesaṃ idaṃ ekaṃ cittaṃ pātubhavati.

In the sense-sphere realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, for all beings, which one feeling... which one perception... which one volition... which one consciousness arises? The mind-consciousness element. In the sense-sphere realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, for all beings, this one consciousness arises.

2. Rūpadhātu

2. The Form Realm

1015. Rūpadhātuyā [V 0.0490] upapattikkhaṇe kati khandhā pātubhavanti…pe… kati cittāni pātubhavanti?

1015. In the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, how many aggregates arise? …pe… How many consciousnesses arise?

Rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe, ṭhapetvā asaññasattānaṃ devānaṃ, pañcakkhandhā pātubhavanti, pañcāyatanāni pātubhavanti, pañca dhātuyo pātubhavanti, ekaṃ saccaṃ pātubhavati, dasindriyāni pātubhavanti, tayo hetū pātubhavanti, tayo āhārā pātubhavanti, eko phasso pātubhavati, ekā vedanā… ekā saññā… ekā cetanā… ekaṃ cittaṃ pātubhavati.

In the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, setting aside the non-percipient devas, five aggregates arise, five sense bases arise, five elements arise, one truth arises, ten faculties arise, three roots arise, three nutriments arise, one contact arises, one feeling… one perception… one volition… one consciousness arises.

1016. Rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe katame pañcakkhandhā pātubhavanti[T 0.0563]? Rūpakkhandho, vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho, viññāṇakkhandho – rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe ime pañcakkhandhā pātubhavanti.

1016. In the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, which five aggregates arise? The form aggregate, the feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, the formations aggregate, and the consciousness aggregate—in the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, these five aggregates arise.

Rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe katamāni pañcāyatanāni pātubhavanti? Cakkhāyatanaṃ, rūpāyatanaṃ, sotāyatanaṃ, manāyatanaṃ, dhammāyatanaṃ – rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe imāni pañcāyatanāni pātubhavanti.

In the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, which five sense bases arise? The eye sense base, the form sense base, the ear sense base, the mind sense base, and the dhamma sense base—in the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, these five sense bases arise.

Rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe katamā pañca dhātuyo pātubhavanti? Cakkhudhātu, rūpadhātu, sotadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu, dhammadhātu – rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe imā pañca dhātuyo pātubhavanti.

In the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, which five elements arise? The eye element, the form element, the ear element, the mind-consciousness element, and the dhamma element—in the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, these five elements arise.

Rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe katamaṃ ekaṃ saccaṃ pātubhavati? Dukkhasaccaṃ – rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe idaṃ ekaṃ saccaṃ pātubhavati.

In the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, which one truth arises? The truth of suffering—in the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, this one truth arises.

Rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe katamāni dasindriyāni pātubhavanti? Cakkhundriyaṃ, sotindriyaṃ, manindriyaṃ, jīvitindriyaṃ, somanassindriyaṃ vā upekkhindriyaṃ vā, saddhindriyaṃ, vīriyindriyaṃ[P 0.0419][V 0.0491], satindriyaṃ, samādhindriyaṃ, paññindriyaṃ – rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe imāni dasindriyāni pātubhavanti.

In the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, which ten faculties appear? The eye faculty, the ear faculty, the mind faculty, the life faculty, either the faculty of joy or the faculty of equanimity, the faith faculty, the energy faculty, the mindfulness faculty, the concentration faculty, and the wisdom faculty—in the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, these ten faculties appear.

Rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe katame tayo hetū pātubhavanti? Alobho vipākahetu, adoso vipākahetu, amoho vipākahetu [M 0.0434] – rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe ime tayo hetū pātubhavanti.

In the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, which three roots appear? Non-greed as a resultant root, non-hatred as a resultant root, and non-delusion as a resultant root—in the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, these three roots appear.

Rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe katame tayo āhārā pātubhavanti? Phassāhāro, manosañcetanāhāro, viññāṇāhāro – rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe ime tayo āhārā pātubhavanti.

In the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, which three nutriments appear? The nutriment of contact, the nutriment of mental volition, and the nutriment of consciousness—in the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, these three nutriments appear.

Rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe katamo eko phasso pātubhavati? Manoviññāṇadhātusamphasso [T 0.0564] – rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe ayaṃ eko phasso pātubhavati.

In the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, which one contact appears? Contact of the mind-consciousness element—in the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, this one contact appears.

Rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe katamā ekā vedanā… ekā saññā… ekā cetanā… ekaṃ cittaṃ pātubhavati? Manoviññāṇadhātu – rūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe idaṃ ekaṃ cittaṃ pātubhavati.

In the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, which one feeling… one perception… one volition… one consciousness appears? The mind-consciousness element—in the form realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, this one consciousness appears.

3. Asaññasattā

3. Non-percipient Beings

1017. Asaññasattānaṃ devānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe kati khandhā pātubhavanti…pe… kati cittāni pātubhavanti?

1017. For the non-percipient devas, at the moment of rebirth-linking, how many aggregates arise? ...pe... how many consciousnesses arise?

Asaññasattānaṃ devānaṃ upapattikkhaṇe eko khandho pātubhavati – rūpakkhandho; dve āyatanāni pātubhavanti – rūpāyatanaṃ, dhammāyatanaṃ; dve dhātuyo pātubhavanti – rūpadhātu, dhammadhātu; ekaṃ saccaṃ pātubhavati – dukkhasaccaṃ; ekindriyaṃ pātubhavati – rūpajīvitindriyaṃ. Asaññasattā devā ahetukā anāhārā aphassakā avedanakā asaññakā acetanakā acittakā pātubhavanti.

For the non-percipient devas, at the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate arises: the aggregate of form. Two sense bases arise: the form base and the dhamma base. Two elements arise: the form element and the dhamma element. One truth arises: the truth of suffering. One faculty arises: the material life faculty. The non-percipient devas arise without roots, without nutriment, without contact, without feeling, without perception, without volition, and without consciousness.

4. Arūpadhātu

4. The Formless Realm

1018. Arūpadhātuyā [V 0.0492] upapattikkhaṇe kati khandhā pātubhavanti…pe… kati cittāni pātubhavanti?

1018. In the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, how many aggregates arise? ...pe... how many consciousnesses arise?

Arūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe cattāro khandhā pātubhavanti, dve āyatanāni pātubhavanti, dve dhātuyo pātubhavanti, ekaṃ saccaṃ pātubhavati, aṭṭhindriyāni pātubhavanti, tayo hetū pātubhavanti, tayo āhārā pātubhavanti, eko phasso pātubhavati, ekā vedanā… ekā saññā… ekā [P 0.0420] cetanā… ekaṃ cittaṃ pātubhavati.

In the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, four aggregates arise, two sense bases arise, two elements arise, one truth arises, eight faculties arise, three roots arise, three nutriments arise, one contact arises, one feeling arises... one perception arises... one volition arises... one consciousness arises.

1019. Arūpadhātuyā [T 0.0565][M 0.0435] upapattikkhaṇe katame cattāro khandhā pātubhavanti? Vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho, viññāṇakkhandho – arūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe ime cattāro khandhā pātubhavanti.

1019. In the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, which four aggregates arise? The feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, the formations aggregate, and the consciousness aggregate—in the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, these four aggregates arise.

Arūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe katamāni dve āyatanāni pātubhavanti? Manāyatanaṃ, dhammāyatanaṃ – arūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe imāni dve āyatanāni pātubhavanti.

In the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, which two sense bases arise? The mind base and the mental-phenomena base—in the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, these two sense bases arise.

Arūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe katamā dve dhātuyo pātubhavanti? Manoviññāṇadhātu, dhammadhātu – arūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe imā dve dhātuyo pātubhavanti.

In the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, which two elements arise? The mind-consciousness element and the dhamma element—in the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, these two elements arise.

Arūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe katamaṃ ekaṃ saccaṃ pātubhavati? Dukkhasaccaṃ – arūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe idaṃ ekaṃ saccaṃ pātubhavati.

In the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, which one truth arises? The truth of suffering—in the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, this one truth arises.

Arūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe katamāni aṭṭhindriyāni pātubhavanti? Manindriyaṃ, jīvitindriyaṃ, upekkhindriyaṃ, saddhindriyaṃ, vīriyindriyaṃ, satindriyaṃ, samādhindriyaṃ, paññindriyaṃ – arūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe imāni aṭṭhindriyāni pātubhavanti.

In the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, which eight faculties arise? The mind faculty, the life faculty, the equanimity faculty, the faith faculty, the energy faculty, the mindfulness faculty, the concentration faculty, and the wisdom faculty—in the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, these eight faculties arise.

Arūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe katame tayo hetū pātubhavanti? Alobho vipākahetu, adoso [V 0.0493] vipākahetu, amoho vipākahetu – arūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe ime tayo hetū pātubhavanti.

In the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, which three roots arise? Non-greed as a resultant root, non-hatred as a resultant root, and non-delusion as a resultant root—in the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, these three roots arise.

Arūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe katame tayo āhārā pātubhavanti? Phassāhāro, manosañcetanāhāro, viññāṇāhāro – arūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe ime tayo āhārā pātubhavanti.

In the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, which three nutriments arise? The nutriment of contact, the nutriment of mental volition, and the nutriment of consciousness—in the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, these three nutriments arise.

Arūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe katamo eko phasso pātubhavati? Manoviññāṇadhātusamphasso [T 0.0566] – arūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe ayaṃ eko phasso pātubhavati.

In the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, which one contact arises? Contact of the mind-consciousness element—in the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, this one contact arises.

Arūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe katamā ekā vedanā…pe… ekā saññā… ekā cetanā… ekaṃ cittaṃ pātubhavati? Manoviññāṇadhātu – arūpadhātuyā upapattikkhaṇe idaṃ ekaṃ cittaṃ pātubhavati.

In the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, which one feeling...pe... one perception... one volition... one consciousness arises? The mind-consciousness element—in the formless realm, at the moment of rebirth-linking, this one consciousness arises.

5. Bhūmantaradassanavāro

5. Section on the Exposition of the Planes

1020. Kāmāvacarā [M 0.0436][P 0.0421] dhammā, na kāmāvacarā dhammā, rūpāvacarā dhammā, na rūpāvacarā dhammā, arūpāvacarā dhammā, na arūpāvacarā dhammā, pariyāpannā dhammā, apariyāpannā dhammā.

1020. Phenomena that frequent the sense-sphere, phenomena that do not frequent the sense-sphere, phenomena that frequent the form-sphere, phenomena that do not frequent the form-sphere, phenomena that frequent the formless-sphere, phenomena that do not frequent the formless-sphere, phenomena included in the three spheres, and phenomena not included in the three spheres.

Katame dhammā kāmāvacarā? Heṭṭhato avīcinirayaṃ pariyantaṃ karitvā, uparito paranimmitavasavattī deve antokaritvā, yaṃ etasmiṃ antare etthāvacarā ettha pariyāpannā khandhadhātuāyatanā; rūpaṃ, vedanā, saññā, saṅkhārā, viññāṇaṃ – ime dhammā kāmāvacarā.

Which phenomena frequent the sense-sphere? Having made the Avīci hell the lower limit and having included the Paranimmitavasavattī devas above, whatever aggregates, elements, and sense-bases frequent this interval and are included herein—form, feeling, perception, formations, and consciousness—these phenomena frequent the sense-sphere.

Katame dhammā na kāmāvacarā? Rūpāvacarā, arūpāvacarā, apariyāpannā – ime dhammā na kāmāvacarā.

Which phenomena do not frequent the sense-sphere? Those that frequent the form-sphere, those that frequent the formless-sphere, and those not included in the three spheres—these phenomena do not frequent the sense-sphere.

Katame dhammā rūpāvacarā? Heṭṭhato brahmalokaṃ pariyantaṃ karitvā, uparito akaniṭṭhe deve antokaritvā[V 0.0494], yaṃ etasmiṃ antare etthāvacarā ettha pariyāpannā samāpannassa vā upapannassa vā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārissa vā cittacetasikā dhammā – ime dhammā rūpāvacarā.

Which phenomena frequent the form-sphere? Having made the Brahmā world the lower limit and having included the Akaniṭṭha gods above, whatever consciousness and mental factors there are that frequent this interval and are included herein—for one who has attained them, or has been reborn there, or is dwelling in blissful abiding in this very life—these phenomena frequent the form-sphere.

Katame dhammā na rūpāvacarā? Kāmāvacarā, arūpāvacarā, apariyāpannā – ime dhammā na rūpāvacarā.

Which phenomena do not frequent the form-sphere? Those that frequent the sense-sphere, those that frequent the formless-sphere, and those not included in the three spheres—these phenomena do not frequent the form-sphere.

Katame dhammā arūpāvacarā? Heṭṭhato ākāsānañcāyatanūpage [T 0.0567] deve pariyantaṃ karitvā, uparito nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpage deve antokaritvā, yaṃ etasmiṃ antare etthāvacarā ettha pariyāpannā samāpannassa vā upapannassa vā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārissa vā cittacetasikā dhammā – ime dhammā arūpāvacarā.

Which phenomena frequent the formless-sphere? Having made the gods who have reached the base of infinite space the lower limit and having included the gods who have reached the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception above, whatever consciousness and mental factors there are that frequent this interval and are included herein—for one who has attained them, or has been reborn there, or is dwelling in blissful abiding in this very life—these phenomena frequent the formless-sphere.

Katame dhammā na arūpāvacarā? Kāmāvacarā, rūpāvacarā, apariyāpannā – ime dhammā na arūpāvacarā.

Which phenomena do not frequent the formless-sphere? Those that frequent the sense-sphere, those that frequent the form-sphere, and those not included in the three spheres—these phenomena do not frequent the formless-sphere.

Katame dhammā pariyāpannā? Sāsavā kusalākusalabyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā, rūpāvacarā, arūpāvacarā, rūpakkhandho, vedanākkhandho, saññākkhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho, viññāṇakkhandho – ime dhammā pariyāpannā.

Which phenomena are included in the three spheres? Tainted wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate phenomena; phenomena that frequent the sense-sphere, phenomena that frequent the form-sphere, phenomena that frequent the formless-sphere; the aggregate of form, the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of formations, and the aggregate of consciousness—these phenomena are included in the three spheres.

Katame dhammā apariyāpannā? Maggā ca, maggaphalāni ca, asaṅkhatā ca dhātu – ime dhammā apariyāpannā.

Which phenomena are not included in the three spheres? The paths, the fruits of the paths, and the unconditioned element—these phenomena are not included in the three spheres.

6. Uppādakakammaāyuppamāṇavāro

6. Section on Productive Kamma and Lifespan

1. Uppādakakammaṃ

1. Productive Kamma

1021. Devāti[M 0.0437][P 0.0422]. Tayo devā – sammutidevā sammatidevā (syā.), upapattidevā, visuddhidevā.

1021. Regarding 'deva': There are three kinds of devas—conventional devas, devas by rebirth, and devas by purity.

Sammutidevā nāma – rājāno, deviyo, kumārā.

Conventional devas are kings, queens, and princes.

Upapattidevā [V 0.0495] nāma – cātumahārājike cātummahārājike (sī. syā.) deve upādāya tadupari devā.

Devas by rebirth are: beginning with the Cātumahārājika devas, the devas above them.

Visuddhidevā nāma – arahanto vuccanti.

Arahants are called devas by purity.

Dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā kattha upapajjanti? Dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā appekacce khattiyamahāsālānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti, appekacce brāhmaṇamahāsālānaṃ [T 0.0568] sahabyataṃ upapajjanti, appekacce gahapatimahāsālānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti, appekacce cātumahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti, appekacce tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti, appekacce yāmānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti, appekacce tusitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti, appekacce nimmānaratīnaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti, appekacce paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti.

Having given alms, undertaken the moral precepts, and performed the Uposatha observance, where are they reborn? Having given alms, undertaken the moral precepts, and performed the Uposatha observance, some are reborn in the company of great Khattiya families, some are reborn in the company of great Brahmin families, some are reborn in the company of great householder families, some are reborn in the company of the Cātumahārājika devas, some are reborn in the company of the Tāvatiṃsa devas, some are reborn in the company of the Yāma devas, some are reborn in the company of the Tusita devas, some are reborn in the company of the Nimmānaratī devas, and some are reborn in the company of the Paranimmitavasavattī devas.

2. Āyuppamāṇaṃ

2. The Measure of Lifespan

1022. Manussānaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Vassasataṃ, appaṃ vā bhiyyo appaṃ vā bhiyyo vā (syā. ka.) dī. ni. 2.7.

1022. What is the measure of the lifespan of humans? A hundred years, or less, or more.

1023. Cātumahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Yāni mānusakāni paññāsa vassāni, cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo rattidivo (ka.) a. ni. 3.71. Tāya rattiyā tiṃsa rattiyo māso. Tena māsena dvādasamāsiyo saṃvaccharo. Tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni pañca vassasatāni cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ. Manussānaṃ gaṇanāya kittakaṃ hoti? Navuti vassasatasahassāni.

1023. What is the measure of the lifespan of the Cātumahārājika devas? Fifty human years are one day and night for the Cātumahārājika devas. By that measure of a night, thirty nights are a month. By that measure of a month, twelve months are a year. By that measure of a year, five hundred divine years are the measure of the lifespan of the Cātumahārājika devas. By human calculation, how much is that? Ninety hundred-thousand years (9,000,000).

Tāvatiṃsānaṃ [M 0.0438] devānaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Yaṃ mānusakaṃ vassasataṃ, tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo. Tāya rattiyā tiṃsa rattiyo māso. Tena māsena dvādasamāsiyo saṃvaccharo. Tena saṃvaccharena dibbaṃ vassasahassaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ. Manussānaṃ gaṇanāya kittakaṃ hoti? Tisso ca vassakoṭiyo saṭṭhi ca vassasatasahassāni.

What is the measure of the lifespan of the Tāvatiṃsa devas? One hundred human years are one day and night for the Tāvatiṃsa devas. By that measure of a night, thirty nights are a month. By that measure of a month, twelve months are a year. By that measure of a year, one thousand divine years are the measure of the lifespan of the Tāvatiṃsa devas. By human calculation, how much is that? Three koṭis and sixty hundred-thousand years (36,000,000).

Yāmānaṃ [V 0.0496] devānaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Yāni mānusakāni dve vassasatāni, yāmānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko [P 0.0423] rattindivo. Tāya rattiyā tiṃsarattiyo māso[T 0.0569]. Tena māsena dvādasamāsiyo saṃvaccharo. Tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni dve vassasahassāni yāmānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ. Manussānaṃ gaṇanāya kittakaṃ hoti? Cuddasañca vassakoṭiyo cattārīsañca vassasatasahassāni.

What is the measure of the lifespan of the Yāma devas? Two hundred human years are one day and night for the Yāma devas. By that measure of a night, thirty nights are a month. By that measure of a month, twelve months are a year. By that measure of a year, two thousand divine years are the measure of the lifespan of the Yāma devas. By human calculation, how much is that? Fourteen koṭis and forty hundred-thousand years (144,000,000).

Tusitānaṃ devānaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Yāni mānusakāni cattāri vassasatāni, tusitānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo. Tāya rattiyā tiṃsarattiyo māso. Tena māsena dvādasamāsiyo saṃvaccharo. Tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni cattāri vassasahassāni tusitānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ. Manussānaṃ gaṇanāya kittakaṃ hoti? Sattapaññāsa vassakoṭiyo saṭṭhi ca vassasatasahassāni.

What is the measure of the lifespan of the Tusita devas? Four hundred human years are one day and night for the Tusita devas. By that measure of a night, thirty nights are a month. By that measure of a month, twelve months are a year. By that measure of a year, four thousand divine years are the measure of the lifespan of the Tusita devas. By human calculation, how much is that? Fifty-seven koṭis and sixty hundred-thousand years (576,000,000).

Nimmānaratīnaṃ devānaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Yāni mānusakāni aṭṭha vassasatāni, nimmānaratīnaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo. Tāya rattiyā tiṃsarattiyo māso. Tena māsena dvādasamāsiyo saṃvaccharo. Tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni aṭṭha vassasahassāni nimmānaratīnaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ. Manussānaṃ gaṇanāya kittakaṃ hoti? Dve vassakoṭisatāni tiṃsañca vassakoṭiyo cattārīsañca vassasatasahassāni.

What is the measure of the lifespan of the Nimmānaratī devas? Eight hundred human years are one day and night for the Nimmānaratī devas. By that measure of a night, thirty nights are a month. By that measure of a month, twelve months are a year. By that measure of a year, eight thousand divine years are the measure of the lifespan of the Nimmānaratī devas. By human calculation, how much is that? Two hundred koṭis, thirty koṭis, and forty hundred-thousand years (2,304,000,000).

Paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Yāni mānusakāni soḷasa vassasatāni, paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo. Tāya rattiyā tiṃsarattiyo māso. Tena māsena dvādasamāsiyo saṃvaccharo. Tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni soḷasa vassasahassāni paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ. Manussānaṃ gaṇanāya kittakaṃ [T 0.0570][M 0.0439] hoti? Nava ca vassakoṭisatāni ekavīsañca vassakoṭiyo saṭṭhi ca vassasatasahassānīti.

What is the measure of the lifespan of the Paranimmitavasavattī devas? Sixteen hundred human years are one day and night for the Paranimmitavasavattī devas. Thirty such days and nights are a month, and twelve such months are a year. By that measure of a year, sixteen thousand divine years are the lifespan of the Paranimmitavasavattī devas. By human calculation, how much is that? Nine hundred koṭis, twenty-one koṭis, and six million years.

Cha ete chapi te (syā.) kāmāvacarā, sabbakāmasamiddhino;

Sabbesaṃ ekasaṅkhāto, āyu bhavati kittako.

These six are of the sense-sphere, endowed with all sensual pleasures; when reckoned as one total for all of them, what is their lifespan?

Dvādasa [V 0.0497] koṭisataṃ tesaṃ, aṭṭhavīsañca koṭiyo;

Paññāsa satasahassāni, vassaggena pakāsitāti.

Their lifespan, declared by the succession of years, is twelve hundred koṭis, twenty-eight koṭis, and five million years.

1024. Paṭhamaṃ [P 0.0424] jhānaṃ parittaṃ bhāvetvā kattha upapajjanti? Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ parittaṃ bhāvetvā brahmapārisajjānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti. Tesaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Kappassa tatiyo bhāgo.

1024. Having developed the first jhāna to a lesser extent, where are they reborn? Having developed the first jhāna to a lesser extent, they are reborn in the company of the devas of Brahmā's Retinue. What is the measure of their lifespan? A third part of a kappa.

Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ majjhimaṃ bhāvetvā kattha upapajjanti? Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ majjhimaṃ bhāvetvā brahmapurohitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti. Tesaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Upaḍḍhakappo.

Having developed the first jhāna to a medium extent, where are they reborn? Having developed the first jhāna to a medium extent, they are reborn in the company of the devas of Brahmā's Ministers. What is the measure of their lifespan? Half a kappa.

Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ paṇītaṃ bhāvetvā kattha upapajjanti? Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ paṇītaṃ bhāvetvā mahābrahmānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti. Tesaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Kappo eko kappo (syā.).

Having developed the first jhāna to a superior extent, where are they reborn? Having developed the first jhāna to a superior extent, they are reborn in the company of the Great Brahmā devas. What is the measure of their lifespan? A kappa.

1025. Dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ parittaṃ bhāvetvā kattha upapajjanti? Dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ parittaṃ bhāvetvā parittābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti. Tesaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Dve kappā.

1025. Having developed the second jhāna to a limited extent, where are they reborn? Having developed the second jhāna to a limited extent, they are reborn in the company of the devas of Limited Radiance. What is the measure of their lifespan? Two kappas.

Dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ majjhimaṃ bhāvetvā kattha upapajjanti? Dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ majjhimaṃ bhāvetvā appamāṇābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti. Tesaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Cattāro kappā.

Having developed the second jhāna to a moderate extent, where are they reborn? Having developed the second jhāna to a moderate extent, they are reborn in the company of the devas of Immeasurable Radiance. What is the measure of their lifespan? Four kappas.

Dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ paṇītaṃ [T 0.0571] bhāvetvā kattha upapajjanti? Dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ paṇītaṃ bhāvetvā ābhassarānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti. Tesaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Aṭṭha kappā.

Having developed the second jhāna to a superior extent, where are they reborn? Having developed the second jhāna to a superior extent, they are reborn in the company of the Ābhassara devas. What is the measure of their lifespan? Eight kappas.

1026. Tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ parittaṃ bhāvetvā kattha upapajjanti? Tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ parittaṃ bhāvetvā parittasubhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti. Tesaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Soḷasa kappā.

1026. Having developed the third jhāna to a limited extent, where are they reborn? Having developed the third jhāna to a limited extent, they are reborn in the company of the devas of Limited Glory. What is the measure of their lifespan? Sixteen kappas.

Tatiyaṃ [M 0.0440] jhānaṃ majjhimaṃ bhāvetvā kattha upapajjanti? Tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ majjhimaṃ bhāvetvā appamāṇasubhānaṃ [V 0.0498] devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti. Tesaṃ [P 0.0425] kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Bāttiṃsa kappā.

Having developed the third jhāna to a moderate extent, where are they reborn? Having developed the third jhāna to a moderate extent, they are reborn in the company of the devas of Immeasurable Glory. What is the measure of their lifespan? Thirty-two kappas.

Tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ paṇītaṃ bhāvetvā kattha upapajjanti? Tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ paṇītaṃ bhāvetvā subhakiṇhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti. Tesaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Catusaṭṭhi kappā.

Having developed the third jhāna to a superior extent, where are they reborn? Having developed the third jhāna to a superior extent, they are reborn in the company of the Subhakiṇṇa devas. What is the measure of their lifespan? Sixty-four kappas.

1027. Catutthaṃ jhānaṃ bhāvetvā ārammaṇanānattatā manasikāranānattatā chandanānattatā paṇidhinānattatā adhimokkhanānattatā abhinīhāranānattatā paññānānattatā appekacce asaññasattānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti, appekacce vehapphalānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti, appekacce avihānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti, appekacce atappānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti, appekacce sudassānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti, appekacce sudassīnaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti, appekacce akaniṭṭhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti, appekacce ākāsānañcāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti, appekacce viññāṇañcāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ [T 0.0572] upapajjanti, appekacce ākiñcaññāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti, appekacce nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjanti.

1027. Having developed the fourth jhāna, due to the diversity of objects, the diversity of attention, the diversity of desire, the diversity of resolve, the diversity of determination, the diversity of aspiration, and the diversity of wisdom—some are reborn in the company of the Non-Percipient devas, some in the company of the Vehapphala devas, some in the company of the Aviha devas, some in the company of the Atappa devas, some in the company of the Sudassa devas, some in the company of the Sudassī devas, some in the company of the Akaniṭṭha devas, some in the company of the devas who have reached the Base of Infinite Space, some in the company of the devas who have reached the Base of Infinite Consciousness, some in the company of the devas who have reached the Base of Nothingness, and some in the company of the devas who have reached the Base of Neither Perception Nor Non-Perception.

Asaññasattānañca vehapphalānañca devānaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Pañcakappasatāni.

What is the measure of the lifespan of the Non-Percipient beings and the Vehapphala devas? Five hundred kappas.

Avihānaṃ devānaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Kappasahassaṃ.

What is the measure of the lifespan of the Aviha devas? One thousand kappas.

Atappānaṃ devānaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Dve kappasahassāni.

What is the measure of the lifespan of the Atappa devas? Two thousand kappas.

Sudassānaṃ devānaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Cattāri kappasahassāni.

What is the measure of the lifespan of the Sudassā devas? Four thousand kappas.

Sudassīnaṃ devānaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Aṭṭha kappasahassāni.

What is the measure of the lifespan of the Sudassī devas? Eight thousand kappas.

Akaniṭṭhānaṃ devānaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Soḷasa kappasahassāni.

What is the measure of the lifespan of the Akaniṭṭha devas? Sixteen thousand kappas.

1028. Ākāsānañcāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Vīsati kappasahassāni.

1028. What is the measure of the lifespan of the devas who have reached the Base of Infinite Space? Twenty thousand kappas.

Viññāṇañcāyatanūpagānaṃ [M 0.0441][V 0.0499] devānaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Cattārīsa kappasahassāni.

What is the measure of the lifespan of the devas who have reached the Base of Infinite Consciousness? Forty thousand kappas.

Ākiñcaññāyatanūpagānaṃ [P 0.0426] devānaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Saṭṭhi kappasahassāni.

What is the measure of the lifespan of the devas who have reached the Base of Nothingness? Sixty thousand kappas.

Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ kittakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ? Caturāsīti kappasahassānīti.

What is the measure of the lifespan of the devas who have reached the Base of Neither Perception Nor Non-Perception? Eighty-four thousand kappas.

1029. Ukkhittā puññatejena, kāmarūpagatiṃ gatā.

1029. Uplifted by the power of merit, they have gone to the sensual and form realms.

Bhavaggatampi bhavaggaṃ vāpi (syā.) sampattā, punāgacchanti puna gacchanti (syā.) duggatiṃ.

Having reached even the highest existence, they return to a woeful state.

Tāva dīghāyukā sattā, cavanti āyusaṅkhayā;

Natthi koci bhavo nicco, iti vuttaṃ mahesinā.

Even such long-lived beings pass away when their lifespan is exhausted; no existence whatsoever is permanent—thus was it spoken by the Great Sage.

Tasmā hi dhīrā nipakā, nipuṇā atthacintakā;

Jarāmaraṇamokkhāya, bhāventi maggamuttamaṃ.

Therefore, the wise, the prudent, the discerning, who consider their own welfare, develop the supreme path for liberation from aging and death.

Bhāvayitvā [T 0.0573] suciṃ maggaṃ, nibbānogadhagāminaṃ;

Sabbāsave pariññāya, parinibbanti anāsavāti.

Having cultivated the pure path that leads to immersion in Nibbāna, and having fully comprehended all the taints, they, being taintless, attain final Nibbāna.

7. Abhiññeyyādivāro

7. The Section on What Should Be Directly Known, etc.

1030. Pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ kati abhiññeyyā, kati pariññeyyā, kati pahātabbā, kati bhāvetabbā, kati sacchikātabbā, kati na pahātabbā, na bhāvetabbā, na sacchikātabbā…pe… sattannaṃ cittānaṃ kati abhiññeyyā, kati pariññeyyā, kati pahātabbā, kati bhāvetabbā, kati sacchikātabbā, kati na pahātabbā na bhāvetabbā na sacchikātabbā?

1030. Of the five aggregates, how many are to be directly known, how many are to be fully comprehended, how many are to be abandoned, how many are to be developed, how many are to be realized, how many are not to be abandoned, not to be developed, not to be realized? …and so on… Of the seven consciousnesses, how many are to be directly known, how many are to be fully comprehended, how many are to be abandoned, how many are to be developed, how many are to be realized, how many are not to be abandoned, not to be developed, not to be realized?

1031. Rūpakkhandho abhiññeyyo pariññeyyo na pahātabbo na bhāvetabbo na sacchikātabbo. Cattāro khandhā abhiññeyyā pariññeyyā, siyā pahātabbā, siyā bhāvetabbā, siyā sacchikātabbā, siyā na pahātabbā na bhāvetabbā na sacchikātabbā.

1031. The form aggregate is to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; it is not to be abandoned, not to be developed, and not to be realized. The four aggregates are to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; some are to be abandoned, some are to be developed, some are to be realized; some are not to be abandoned, not to be developed, and not to be realized.

Dasāyatanā [M 0.0442][V 0.0500] abhiññeyyā pariññeyyā na pahātabbā na bhāvetabbā na sacchikātabbā. Dve āyatanā abhiññeyyā pariññeyyā, siyā pahātabbā, siyā bhāvetabbā, siyā sacchikātabbā, siyā na pahātabbā na bhāvetabbā na sacchikātabbā.

Ten bases are to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; they are not to be abandoned, not to be developed, and not to be realized. Two bases are to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; some are to be abandoned, some are to be developed, some are to be realized; some are not to be abandoned, not to be developed, and not to be realized.

Soḷasa dhātuyo abhiññeyyā pariññeyyā na pahātabbā na bhāvetabbā na sacchikātabbā. Dve dhātuyo abhiññeyyā pariññeyyā, siyā pahātabbā, siyā bhāvetabbā, siyā sacchikātabbā, siyā na pahātabbā na bhāvetabbā na sacchikātabbā.

Sixteen elements are to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; they are not to be abandoned, not to be developed, and not to be realized. Two elements are to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; some are to be abandoned, some are to be developed, some are to be realized; some are not to be abandoned, not to be developed, and not to be realized.

Samudayasaccaṃ abhiññeyyaṃ pariññeyyaṃ pahātabbaṃ na [T 0.0574] bhāvetabbaṃ na sacchikātabbaṃ. Maggasaccaṃ abhiññeyyaṃ pariññeyyaṃ na pahātabbaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ na sacchikātabbaṃ[P 0.0427]. Nirodhasaccaṃ abhiññeyyaṃ pariññeyyaṃ na pahātabbaṃ na bhāvetabbaṃ sacchikātabbaṃ. Dukkhasaccaṃ abhiññeyyaṃ pariññeyyaṃ, siyā pahātabbaṃ, na bhāvetabbaṃ, na sacchikātabbaṃ, siyā na pahātabbaṃ.

The truth of the origin is to be directly known, to be fully comprehended, and to be abandoned; it is not to be developed and not to be realized. The truth of the path is to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; it is not to be abandoned but is to be developed; it is not to be realized. The truth of cessation is to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; it is not to be abandoned and not to be developed but is to be realized. The truth of suffering is to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; some of it is to be abandoned; it is not to be developed and not to be realized; some of it is not to be abandoned.

Navindriyā abhiññeyyā pariññeyyā na pahātabbā na bhāvetabbā na sacchikātabbā. Domanassindriyaṃ abhiññeyyaṃ pariññeyyaṃ pahātabbaṃ na bhāvetabbaṃ na sacchikātabbaṃ. Anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ abhiññeyyaṃ pariññeyyaṃ na pahātabbaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ na sacchikātabbaṃ. Aññindriyaṃ abhiññeyyaṃ pariññeyyaṃ na pahātabbaṃ, siyā bhāvetabbaṃ, siyā sacchikātabbaṃ. Aññātāvindriyaṃ abhiññeyyaṃ pariññeyyaṃ na pahātabbaṃ na bhāvetabbaṃ sacchikātabbaṃ. Tīṇindriyā abhiññeyyā pariññeyyā na pahātabbā, siyā bhāvetabbā, siyā sacchikātabbā, siyā na bhāvetabbā, sacchikātabbā. Cha indriyā abhiññeyyā pariññeyyā, siyā pahātabbā, siyā bhāvetabbā, siyā sacchikātabbā, siyā na pahātabbā na bhāvetabbā na sacchikātabbā.

Nine faculties are to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; they are not to be abandoned, not to be developed, and not to be realized. The faculty of displeasure is to be directly known, to be fully comprehended, and to be abandoned; it is not to be developed and not to be realized. The faculty of 'I shall know the unknown' is to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; it is not to be abandoned but is to be developed; it is not to be realized. The faculty of final knowledge is to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; it is not to be abandoned; some of it is to be developed, and some of it is to be realized. The faculty of one who knows is to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; it is not to be abandoned and not to be developed but is to be realized. Three faculties are to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; they are not to be abandoned; some are to be developed, some are to be realized; some are not to be developed, and some are not to be realized. Six faculties are to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; some are to be abandoned, some are to be developed, some are to be realized; some are not to be abandoned, not to be developed, and not to be realized.

Tayo akusalahetū abhiññeyyā pariññeyyā pahātabbā na bhāvetabbā na sacchikātabbā. Tayo kusalahetū abhiññeyyā pariññeyyā na pahātabbā, siyā bhāvetabbā, na sacchikātabbā, siyā na bhāvetabbā. Tayo abyākatahetū abhiññeyyā pariññeyyā na pahātabbā na bhāvetabbā, siyā sacchikātabbā[T 0.0575], siyā na sacchikātabbā.

The three unwholesome roots are to be directly known, to be fully comprehended, and to be abandoned; they are not to be developed and not to be realized. The three wholesome roots are to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; they are not to be abandoned and not to be realized; some are to be developed, and some are not to be developed. The three indeterminate roots are to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; they are not to be abandoned and not to be developed; some are to be realized, and some are not to be realized.

Kabaḷīkāro [M 0.0443][V 0.0501] āhāro abhiññeyyo pariññeyyo na pahātabbo na bhāvetabbo na sacchikātabbo. Tayo āhārā abhiññeyyā pariññeyyā, siyā pahātabbā, siyā bhāvetabbā, siyā sacchikātabbā, siyā na pahātabbā na bhāvetabbā na sacchikātabbā.

Physical food is to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; it is not to be abandoned, not to be developed, and not to be realized. The three foods are to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; some are to be abandoned, some are to be developed, some are to be realized; some are not to be abandoned, not to be developed, and not to be realized.

Cha phassā abhiññeyyā pariññeyyā na pahātabbā na bhāvetabbā na sacchikātabbā. Manoviññāṇadhātusamphasso abhiññeyyo pariññeyyo, siyā pahātabbo, siyā bhāvetabbo, siyā sacchikātabbo, siyā na pahātabbo na bhāvetabbo na sacchikātabbo.

Six contacts are to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; they are not to be abandoned, not to be developed, and not to be realized. Contact of the mind-consciousness element is to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; some is to be abandoned, some is to be developed, some is to be realized; some is not to be abandoned, not to be developed, and not to be realized.

Cha vedanā…pe… cha saññā… cha cetanā… cha cittā abhiññeyyā pariññeyyā na pahātabbā na bhāvetabbā na sacchikātabbā. Manoviññāṇadhātu abhiññeyyā pariññeyyā, siyā pahātabbā, siyā bhāvetabbā, siyā sacchikātabbā[P 0.0428], siyā na pahātabbā na bhāvetabbā na sacchikātabbā.

Six feelings… and so on… six perceptions… six volitions… six consciousnesses are to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; they are not to be abandoned, not to be developed, and not to be realized. The mind-consciousness element is to be directly known and to be fully comprehended; some is to be abandoned, some is to be developed, some is to be realized; some is not to be abandoned, not to be developed, and not to be realized.

8. Sārammaṇānārammaṇavāro

8. The Section on With an Object and Without an Object

1032. Pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ kati sārammaṇā, kati anārammaṇā…pe… sattannaṃ cittānaṃ kati sārammaṇā, kati anārammaṇā?

1032. Of the five aggregates, how many are with an object, how many are without an object?…and so on… Of the seven consciousnesses, how many are with an object, how many are without an object?

1033. Rūpakkhandho anārammaṇo. Cattāro khandhā sārammaṇā.

1033. The form aggregate is without an object. The four aggregates are with an object.

Dasāyatanā anārammaṇā. Manāyatanaṃ sārammaṇaṃ. Dhammāyatanaṃ siyā sārammaṇaṃ, siyā anārammaṇaṃ.

Ten bases are without an object. The mind base is with an object. The mental-phenomena base may be with an object or may be without an object.

Dasa dhātuyo anārammaṇā. Satta dhātuyo sārammaṇā. Dhammadhātu siyā sārammaṇā, siyā anārammaṇā.

Ten elements are without an object. Seven elements are with an object. The mental-phenomena element may be with an object or may be without an object.

Dve [T 0.0576] saccā sārammaṇā. Nirodhasaccaṃ anārammaṇaṃ. Dukkhasaccaṃ siyā sārammaṇaṃ, siyā anārammaṇaṃ.

Two truths are with an object. The truth of cessation is without an object. The truth of suffering may be with an object or may be without an object.

Sattindriyā [V 0.0502] anārammaṇā. Cuddasindriyā sārammaṇā. Jīvitindriyaṃ siyā sārammaṇaṃ, siyā anārammaṇaṃ. Nava hetū sārammaṇā. Kabaḷīkāro āhāro anārammaṇo. Tayo āhārā sārammaṇā. Satta phassā… satta vedanā… satta saññā… satta cetanā… satta cittā sārammaṇā.

Seven faculties are without an object. Fourteen faculties are with an object. The life faculty may be with an object or may be without an object. Nine roots are with an object. Physical nutriment is without an object. Three nutriments are with an object. Seven contacts… seven feelings… seven perceptions… seven volitions… seven consciousnesses are with an object.

1034. Pañcannaṃ [M 0.0444] khandhānaṃ kati sārammaṇārammaṇā, kati anārammaṇārammaṇā…pe… sattannaṃ cittānaṃ kati sārammaṇārammaṇā, kati anārammaṇārammaṇā?

1034. Of the five aggregates, how many take as their object a state that is with an object? How many take as their object a state that is without an object? …and so on… Of the seven consciousnesses, how many take as their object a state that is with an object? How many take as their object a state that is without an object?

1035. Rūpakkhandho anārammaṇo. Cattāro khandhā siyā sārammaṇārammaṇā, siyā anārammaṇārammaṇā.

1035. The aggregate of form does not take an object. The four aggregates sometimes take an object that has an object, and sometimes take an object that does not have an object.

Dasāyatanā anārammaṇā. Manāyatanaṃ siyā sārammaṇārammaṇaṃ, siyā anārammaṇārammaṇaṃ. Dhammāyatanaṃ siyā sārammaṇārammaṇaṃ, siyā anārammaṇārammaṇaṃ, siyā anārammaṇaṃ.

Ten sense bases do not take an object. The mind base sometimes takes an object that has an object, and sometimes takes an object that does not have an object. The base of mental phenomena sometimes takes an object that has an object, sometimes takes an object that does not have an object, and sometimes does not take an object.

Dasa dhātuyo anārammaṇā. Cha dhātuyo anārammaṇārammaṇā. Manoviññāṇadhātu siyā sārammaṇārammaṇā, siyā anārammaṇārammaṇā. Dhammadhātu siyā sārammaṇārammaṇā, siyā anārammaṇārammaṇā, siyā anārammaṇā.

Ten elements do not take an object. Six elements take an object that does not have an object. The mind-consciousness element sometimes takes an object that has an object, and sometimes takes an object that does not have an object. The element of mental phenomena sometimes takes an object that has an object, sometimes takes an object that does not have an object, and sometimes does not take an object.

Nirodhasaccaṃ anārammaṇaṃ. Maggasaccaṃ anārammaṇārammaṇaṃ. Samudayasaccaṃ siyā sārammaṇārammaṇaṃ, siyā anārammaṇārammaṇaṃ. Dukkhasaccaṃ [P 0.0429] siyā sārammaṇārammaṇaṃ, siyā anārammaṇārammaṇaṃ, siyā anārammaṇaṃ.

The truth of cessation does not take an object. The truth of the path takes an object that does not have an object. The truth of origin sometimes takes an object that has an object, and sometimes takes an object that does not have an object. The truth of suffering sometimes takes an object that has an object, sometimes takes an object that does not have an object, and sometimes does not take an object.

Sattindriyā anārammaṇā. Pañcindriyā [T 0.0577] anārammaṇārammaṇā. Navindriyā siyā sārammaṇārammaṇā, siyā anārammaṇārammaṇā. Jīvitindriyaṃ siyā sārammaṇārammaṇaṃ, siyā anārammaṇārammaṇaṃ, siyā anārammaṇaṃ.

Seven faculties do not take an object. Five faculties take an object that does not have an object. Nine faculties sometimes take an object that has an object, and sometimes take an object that does not have an object. The life faculty sometimes takes an object that has an object, sometimes takes an object that does not have an object, and sometimes does not take an object.

Nava hetū siyā sārammaṇārammaṇā, siyā anārammaṇārammaṇā. Kabaḷīkāro āhāro anārammaṇo. Tayo āhārā siyā sārammaṇārammaṇā, siyā anārammaṇārammaṇā. Cha phassā anārammaṇārammaṇā[V 0.0503]. Manoviññāṇadhātusamphasso siyā sārammaṇārammaṇo siyā anārammaṇārammaṇo. Cha vedanā… cha saññā… cha cetanā… cha cittā anārammaṇārammaṇā. Manoviññāṇadhātu siyā sārammaṇārammaṇā, siyā anārammaṇārammaṇā.

Nine roots sometimes take an object that has an object, and sometimes take an object that does not have an object. Physical nutriment does not take an object. Three nutriments sometimes take an object that has an object, and sometimes take an object that does not have an object. Six contacts take an object that does not have an object. Contact of the mind-consciousness element sometimes takes an object that has an object, and sometimes takes an object that does not have an object. Six feelings… six perceptions… six volitions… six consciousnesses take an object that does not have an object. The mind-consciousness element sometimes takes an object that has an object, and sometimes takes an object that does not have an object.

9. Diṭṭhasutādidassanavāro

9. The Section on What is Seen, Heard, etc.

1036. Pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ kati diṭṭhā, kati sutā, kati mutā, kati viññātā, kati na diṭṭhā na sutā na mutā na viññātā…pe… sattannaṃ cittānaṃ kati [M 0.0445] diṭṭhā, kati sutā, kati mutā, kati viññātā, kati na diṭṭhā na sutā na mutā na viññātā?

1036. Of the five aggregates, how many are seen? How many are heard? How many are sensed? How many are cognized? How many are not seen? How many are not heard? How many are not sensed? How many are not cognized? …and so on… Of the seven consciousnesses, how many are seen? How many are heard? How many are sensed? How many are cognized? How many are not seen? How many are not heard? How many are not sensed? How many are not cognized?

1037. Rūpakkhandho siyā diṭṭho, siyā suto, siyā muto, siyā viññāto, siyā na diṭṭho na suto na muto, viññāto. Cattāro khandhā na diṭṭhā na sutā na mutā, viññātā.

1037. The aggregate of form is sometimes seen, sometimes heard, sometimes sensed, sometimes cognized; sometimes it is not seen, not heard, not sensed, but is cognized. The four [mental] aggregates are not seen, not heard, not sensed, but are cognized.

Rūpāyatanaṃ diṭṭhaṃ, na sutaṃ na mutaṃ, viññātaṃ. Saddāyatanaṃ na diṭṭhaṃ, sutaṃ, na mutaṃ, viññātaṃ. Gandhāyatanaṃ… rasāyatanaṃ… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ na diṭṭhaṃ na sutaṃ, mutaṃ, viññātaṃ. Sattāyatanā na diṭṭhā na sutā na [T 0.0578] mutā, viññātā.

The base of form is seen, not heard, not sensed, but is cognized. The base of sound is not seen, is heard, not sensed, but is cognized. The base of smell, the base of taste, and the base of touch are not seen, not heard, are sensed, and are cognized. The seven bases are not seen, not heard, not sensed, but are cognized.

Rūpadhātu diṭṭhā, na sutā na mutā, viññātā. Saddadhātu na diṭṭhā, sutā, na mutā, viññātā. Gandhadhātu… rasadhātu… phoṭṭhabbadhātu na diṭṭhā na sutā, mutā, viññātā. Terasa dhātuyo na diṭṭhā na sutā na mutā, viññātā.

The element of form is seen, not heard, not sensed, but is cognized. The element of sound is not seen, is heard, not sensed, but is cognized. The element of smell, the element of taste, and the element of touch are not seen, not heard, are sensed, and are cognized. The thirteen elements are not seen, not heard, not sensed, but are cognized.

Tīṇi saccāni na diṭṭhā na sutā na mutā, viññātā. Dukkhasaccaṃ siyā diṭṭhaṃ, siyā sutaṃ, siyā mutaṃ, siyā viññātaṃ, siyā na diṭṭhaṃ na sutaṃ na mutaṃ, viññātaṃ.

Three truths are not seen, not heard, not sensed, but are cognized. The truth of suffering is sometimes seen, sometimes heard, sometimes sensed, sometimes cognized; and sometimes it is not seen, not heard, not sensed, but is cognized.

Bāvīsatindriyā na diṭṭhā na sutā na mutā, viññātā. Nava hetū na diṭṭhā na sutā na mutā, viññātā. Cattāro āhārā na diṭṭhā na sutā na mutā, viññātā. Satta [P 0.0430] phassā [V 0.0504] na diṭṭhā na sutā na mutā, viññātā. Satta vedanā… satta saññā… satta cetanā… satta cittā na diṭṭhā na sutā na mutā, viññātā.

Twenty-two faculties are not seen, not heard, not sensed, but are cognized. Nine roots are not seen, not heard, not sensed, but are cognized. Four nutriments are not seen, not heard, not sensed, but are cognized. Seven contacts are not seen, not heard, not sensed, but are cognized. Seven feelings, seven perceptions, seven volitions, and seven consciousnesses are not seen, not heard, not sensed, but are cognized.

10. Tikādidassanavāro

10. Section Showing the Triads, etc.

1. Kusalattikaṃ

1. The Wholesome Triad

1038. Pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ kati kusalā, kati akusalā, kati abyākatā…pe… sattannaṃ cittānaṃ kati kusalā, kati akusalā, kati abyākatā?

1038. Of the five aggregates, how many are wholesome, how many are unwholesome, and how many are indeterminate? …and so on… Of the seven consciousnesses, how many are wholesome, how many are unwholesome, and how many are indeterminate?
